items.en: The adverb prope and adjective propinquus name what is near.
items.cn: 副词 prope 与形容词 propinquus 都表示「近的」。

items.en: The superlative proximus is the core meaning nearest.
items.cn: 最高级 proximus 是核心形式，意为「最近的」。

items.en: The abstract noun proxime is attested in late usage.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语可见抽象名词 proxime 的用法。

items.en: Proximite carries the abstract idea into French.
items.cn: proximite 把这一抽象概念带进法语。

items.en: Proximity enters English as a learned term for nearness.
items.cn: proximity 以拉丁化学术词的身份进入英语，表示「接近」。

items.en: Technology and statistics give it the measured sense of degree of closeness.
items.cn: 现代科技与统计学赋予它「接近程度」的测量义。

note.en: Proximity is the abstract nearness noun of the prope family, close to approximate and to words like closeness and adjacency, but not to proxy, which shares spelling only.
note.cn: proximity 是 prope 词族里表示「近」的抽象名词，与 approximate 同根，也与 closeness、adjacency 近义；它与 proxy 只是拼写相近，词源不同。

entries.definition: situated nearer to the centre or point of attachment
entries.definitionCN: 更靠近中心或附着点的；近端的

entries.definition: closest in space or relationship, or immediately preceding a result
entries.definitionCN: 最接近的；直接的（原因）

entries.definition: almost correct or accurate, but not exactly so
entries.definitionCN: 近似的；接近的——与 proximity 共享拉丁词根 proxim

entries.definition: the state of being next to something
entries.definitionCN: 毗邻；紧挨着

entries.definition: the area near or around a place
entries.definitionCN: 附近；周边地区

entries.definition: the state of being near, or of being intimate
entries.definitionCN: 接近；亲密（日常用词）

normalIntro.en: Proximity is the Latin nearest built into an abstract noun, so it always names a state of nearness rather than a place.
normalIntro.cn: proximity 是把拉丁语「最近的」装进抽象名词，因此总表示一种「近」的状态，而不是某个地点。

normal.en: In close proximity to means right next to.
normal.cn: in close proximity to 表示紧靠着。

normal.en: The proximo stem appears in approximate and proximal.
normal.cn: proxim 词干出现在 approximate 与 proximal 之中。

normal.en: Proximity to the station raises house prices.
normal.cn: proximity to the station 指离车站近，会抬高房价。

normal.en: The -ity ending marks an abstract noun, like activity.
normal.cn: -ity 词尾标记抽象名词，与 activity 同理。

normal.en: Compare vicinity: vicinity is the area around, proximity is the fact of being near.
normal.cn: 对比 vicinity：vicinity 是周围那一片区域，proximity 是「离得近」这件事。

abstract.en: Picture two lamps so close that their light rings overlap.
abstract.cn: 想象两盏灯挨得很近，光圈彼此交叠。

abstract.en: Imagine two festival dates falling in the same week.
abstract.cn: 想象两个节日落在同一周里。

abstract.en: See two nearly identical drawings, different only in one line.
abstract.cn: 想象两幅几乎一样的画，只差一笔。

examples.en: The villagers lived in close proximity to the river.
examples.cn: 村民们紧挨着河流居住。

examples.en: Its proximity to the capital made the town a trading hub.
examples.cn: 这座城镇因靠近首都而成为贸易中心。

examples.en: The proximity of the two dates caused a scheduling conflict.
examples.cn: 两个日期太接近，导致日程冲突。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「扑克西米提」——两人凑近打扑克，西米摆一堆，离得真近；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 prope（近）→ 最高级 proximus（最近的）→ 晚期拉丁 proxime → 英语 proximity，核心义「离得最近」。

sensesIntro.en: Proximity begins as pure nearness in space, then extends to nearness in time, in resemblance or relation, in measured degree, and finally to the accessible area around a place.
sensesIntro.cn: proximity 起初是纯粹的空间接近，再扩展到时间上的临近、性质或关系上的相近、可测量的接近程度，最后指某地周围可到达的区域。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two lamps so close that their light overlaps.
core.cn: 核心意象：两盏灯近到光圈交叠。

branches.en: Nearness in space is the literal first sense.
branches.cn: 空间上的接近是最直接的第一个义项。

branches.en: Distance in space and distance in time both come from the same idea of gaps.
branches.cn: 空间距离与时间距离都来自同一个「间隔」概念。

branches.en: Resemblance or close relation is nearness without a ruler.
branches.cn: 相似或关系密切是一种不用尺子量的「近」。

branches.en: Measuring proximity turns the state into a number.
branches.cn: 对 proximity 加以测量，就把状态变成了数字。

branches.en: The neighbourhood sense names the area rather than the fact.
branches.cn: 「附近」义项指的是那片区域，而不是「近」这件事。

intro.en: Proximity is built from the Latin root proxim, nearest, and the abstract noun ending -ity.
intro.cn: proximity 由拉丁词根 proxim（最近的）与抽象名词词尾 -ity 构成。

latinIntro.en: Latin proximus is the superlative of prope, and its root proxim- means the nearest.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 proximus 是 prope 的最高级，词根 proxim- 意为「最近的」。

items.example: The root proxim- appears in all family members.
items.exampleCN: 词根 proxim- 出现在所有同族词中。

items.example: The suffix -ity forms activity in the same way.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ity 同样构成 activity。

items.example: Proximus is the direct ancestor of the noun.
items.exampleCN: proximus 是该名词的直接祖先。

items.example: Proximity keeps the abstract sense.
items.exampleCN: proximity 保留了抽象含义。

items.example: The suffix -al forms proximal.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -al 构成 proximal。

items.example: Proximal is common in medical texts.
items.exampleCN: proximal 常见于医学文本。

items.example: The suffix -ate forms proximate.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ate 构成 proximate。

items.example: Proximate often names a direct cause.
items.exampleCN: proximate 常指直接原因。

items.example: Approximate adds the prefix ap- meaning toward.
items.exampleCN: approximate 加了表示「朝向」的前缀 ap-。

definition_zh: 代理人；受托人；代理权；委托书；代理服务器；替身；替代指标
definition_en: a person or thing that is given the authority to act for someone else, or a stand-in or substitute that represents something else
core_image: 一个人把授权书递到别人手里，自己退到后景
scene: 股东们太忙，无法亲自到会，于是委托别人代为投票。She voted by proxy because she was travelling abroad.
sceneCN: 这里 proxy 是「代理权、委托投票」（第 3 个义项：由他人代为行使的权利）；句意：她因为在国外旅行，所以委托他人代为投票。

pos.zh: 代理人；受托人；代理权；委托书
代理服务器；替身；替代指标
代理的；代用的（常用于 proxy server、proxy war 等搭配）

derivatives.zh: procur（代管、照料）+ -ator；义为「代理人；检察官」，与 proxy 共享拉丁语「代为照管」的词根线索
procuracy 由 procurator 派生的抽象名词，义为「代理权；代理职责」
pro-（向前、为了）+ cura（照管）；义为「设法获得；采购」，是同根词族中的常用动词

senses.title: A person authorised to act for another
senses.definition: a person who is legally authorised to act on behalf of someone else
senses.definitionCN: 依法获得授权、代他人行事的人
senses.example: Her lawyer attended the meeting as her proxy.
senses.exampleCN: 她的律师作为她的代理人出席了会议。
senses.why: Middle English procuracie, from Latin procurare, means the office of caring for something on another behalf, and it narrowed to the person holding that office.
senses.whyCN: 中古英语 procuracie 来自拉丁语 procurare，本义是「代他人照管事务的职务」，后来词义收窄，指担任这一职务的人。

senses.title: The authority to represent someone
senses.definition: the power, or the written document, that allows one person to act in place of another
senses.definitionCN: 允许一个人代替另一个人行事的权力或书面文件
senses.example: The bank asked for a proxy signed by both owners.
senses.exampleCN: 银行要求提供一份由两位业主共同签署的委托书。
senses.why: The office of caring for another matters partly because the office includes a licence to sign, so the abstract word came to name that written power.
senses.whyCN: 代管职务之所以重要，是因为它本身包含签字的许可，于是抽象词也用来指这份书面的权力。

senses.title: Voting on behalf of an absent member
senses.titleCN: 代理投票；代为行使权利
senses.definition: the arrangement by which a member gives another the right to cast a vote in his or her place
senses.definitionCN: 成员把投票权交给他人、由他人代为投票的安排
senses.example: Many shareholders voted by proxy at the annual meeting.
senses.exampleCN: 许多股东在年会上通过委托方式投票。
senses.why: Voting is the most common exercise of a deputy power, so proxy became the everyday word for casting a vote in someone else place.
senses.whyCN: 投票是代理权最常见的行使方式，因此 proxy 成了「替别人投票」的日常说法。

senses.title: A stand-in or substitute
senses.definition: something that serves in place of another thing and stands for it
senses.definitionCN: 代替另一事物并代表它的东西
senses.example: The finished sculpture served as a proxy for the lost original.
senses.exampleCN: 这尊成品雕塑被当作失落原作的替身。
senses.why: If a person may act in another name, an object may stand in another place, and the substitution sense follows directly.
senses.whyCN: 既然人可以借另一个人的名义行事，物件也可以占据另一个物件的位置，替代义项便由此顺理成章地产生。

senses.title: A substitute that stands in for another actor or state
senses.titleCN: 代理人（战争、外交中的替代者）
senses.definition: a group or country that acts on behalf of a more powerful partner without formally fighting itself
senses.definitionCN: 代表更强大的伙伴行动、但并不正式亲自出场的集团或国家
senses.example: The two powers fought through local proxies.
senses.exampleCN: 两个大国借当地的代理势力交锋。
senses.why: States hide behind partners the same way an individual hides behind a deputy, so the political sense borrows the person sense.
senses.whyCN: 国家借伙伴出面，正如个人借代理人出面，所以政治义项直接借用了「人」的义项。

senses.title: An intermediate computer service
senses.definition: a computer or program that handles requests on behalf of another computer and relays the results
senses.definitionCN: 代另一台计算机处理请求并转达结果的计算机或程序
senses.example: The browser connects through an anonymous proxy.
senses.exampleCN: 浏览器通过一个匿名代理服务器联网。
senses.why: A server that answers for your machine reproduces the deputy relation inside a network, giving a technical sense of the same idea.
senses.whyCN: 代表你的机器应答的服务器，在网络内部复制了「代办」的关系，由此产生了同一思路的技术义项。

senses.title: An indirect indicator
senses.definition: a measured quantity used as an indirect sign of something that cannot be measured directly
senses.definitionCN: 用来间接反映某种无法直接测量之物的测量值
senses.example: Tree rings are a proxy for past rainfall.
senses.exampleCN: 树木年轮是过去降雨量的替代指标。
senses.why: What stands in place of a thing also stands in place of its value, so a measured stand-in becomes a proxy for what cannot be measured.
senses.whyCN: 能代替某物的东西，也能代替它的数值，于是可测量的替身就成了不可测之物的替代指标。

intro.en: Proxy is a shortened form of Middle English procuracie, from Latin procuratio, the office of a procurator who manages affairs for another.
intro.cn: proxy 是中古英语 procuracie 的缩略形式，源自拉丁语 procuratio，指 procurator 代他人管理事务的职务。

items.en: Procurare means to take care of or manage something for another.
items.cn: procurare 意为替他人照管或管理事务。

items.en: Procuratio and procurator name the managing office and the appointed agent.
items.cn: procuratio 与 procurator 分别指代管职务与受任代管者。

items.en: Procuration, with the t of the Latin stem, passes into French.
items.cn: 带拉丁词干 t 的 procuration 传入法语。

items.en: Procuracie names the office and the authority of a deputy.
items.cn: procuracie 指代管职务以及代理人的权限。

items.en: A clipped form, spelled proximity-like as procky and then proxy, spreads in legal and church records.
items.cn: 缩略形式先在法律与教会文书中流传，早期拼写多种多样，最终定型为 proxy。

items.en: The computer sense of a proxy server appears in the twentieth century.
items.cn: 二十世纪出现了「代理服务器」这一计算机义项。

note.en: Proxy belongs to the Latin caring-for-another family and sits near agent and delegate; it only looks like proximity and has a different root.
note.cn: proxy 属于拉丁语「代他人照管」词族，与 agent、delegate 近义；它只是看起来像 proximity，词源完全不同。

entries.definition: the state of being near
entries.definitionCN: 接近；邻近——只是与 proxy 开头拼写相近，词源不同（一词来自 proximus，一词来自 procurare）

entries.definition: an official who manages affairs for another
entries.definitionCN: 代理人；代管者（与 proxy 同出拉丁 procurare）

entries.definition: to obtain something, especially with effort
entries.definitionCN: 设法获得；采购——同根动词，保留「照料、操办」的意味

entries.definition: a person who acts on behalf of another
entries.definitionCN: 代理人；经纪人

entries.definition: a person sent to represent a group
entries.definitionCN: 代表；代表者

entries.definition: a person or thing used in place of another
entries.definitionCN: 替代者；替代品

normalIntro.en: Proxy is a worn-down legal word for a deputy, so it points at whoever acts in your place, and later at whatever stands in for a thing.
normalIntro.cn: proxy 是一个被磨短的法律词，指「代办人」，先是代为行动的人，后来也指替代某物的东西。

normal.en: To vote by proxy is to let someone else cast your vote.
normal.cn: vote by proxy 就是让别人替你投票。

normal.en: A proxy server stands between your computer and the wider network.
normal.cn: proxy server 站在你的电脑与更广阔的网络之间。

normal.en: A proxy war is fought by others on behalf of powerful backers.
normal.cn: proxy war 是由他人代强国进行的战争。

normal.en: The Latin stem procur- also gives procure and procurator.
normal.cn: 拉丁词干 procur- 还构成 procure 与 procurator。

normal.en: Compare proximity: similar spelling, different root; proxy is about acting for another.
normal.cn: 对比 proximity：拼写相似但词根不同，proxy 讲的是「替别人办事」。

abstract.en: Picture a signed letter passing from one hand to another before a vote.
abstract.cn: 想象投票前一张签好字的授权书从一只手传到另一只手。

abstract.en: See a shadow in court standing where the real person should be.
abstract.cn: 想象法庭上一个影子站在真人本该站的位置。

abstract.en: Think of tree rings silently recording rain that nobody could watch.
abstract.cn: 想象年轮默默记录无人看得到的降雨。

examples.en: He chose to vote by proxy rather than miss the vote.
examples.cn: 他选择委托他人投票，而不是错过这次投票。

examples.en: The company uses a proxy to filter web traffic.
examples.cn: 公司使用一台代理服务器来过滤网络流量。

examples.en: Ice cores act as a proxy for ancient temperatures.
examples.cn: 冰芯可以作为古代气温的替代指标。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「扑若西」——票若交给西边那位的代理人，就是委托投票；这是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 procurare（代他人照管）→ procuratio（代办职务）→ 中古英语 procuracie → 缩略为 proxy，核心义「替人出面」。

sensesIntro.en: Proxy starts as the office of a deputy, then names the deputy and the written authority, and grows into voting by substitute; from there it extends to any stand-in, to political and military stand-ins, to a network service, and finally to an indirect measurement.
sensesIntro.cn: proxy 最初指代办的职务，接着指代办的人、委托书，再到代为投票；由此扩展到任何替身、政治与军事上的代理者、网络服务，最后延伸到间接测量用的替代指标。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an authorising letter handed to someone who acts in your place.
core.cn: 核心意象：把授权书交到替你出面的人手中。

branches.en: The person who acts for another is the oldest concrete sense.
branches.cn: 代他人行事的人是最古老的具体义项。

branches.en: A deputy and the written authority that empowers the deputy always travel together.
branches.cn: 代理人与赋予其权限的委托书总是成对出现。

branches.en: Voting for an absent member and fighting for a backer are both acting in another name.
branches.cn: 替缺席成员投票与替背后支持者交战，都属于借他人之名行事。

branches.en: The stand-in sense is technical: a substitute object and a substitute server.
branches.cn: 替身义项偏技术：替身的物件与替身的服务器。

branches.en: An indirect indicator is a stand-in for a value that cannot be seen directly.
branches.cn: 间接指标是无法直接观测到的数值的替身。

intro.en: Proxy carries the Latin stem procur-, meaning to look after something for someone, with the Latin noun ending stripped away over centuries.
intro.cn: proxy 承载拉丁词干 procur-（替人照管），数百年间词尾被逐渐磨掉。

latinIntro.en: Latin cura means care, and the verb procurare means to take care of affairs on behalf of another.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 cura 意为「照料」，动词 procurare 意为「替他人照管事务」。

items.example: The prefix pro- marks acting for someone.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 pro- 标记「代表某人」。

items.example: Cura is the caring element of the root.
items.exampleCN: cura 是该词根的「照管」部分。

items.example: Procurare gives the whole family its meaning.
items.exampleCN: procurare 给整个词族提供含义。

items.example: Procuratio is the direct legal ancestor.
items.exampleCN: procuratio 是直接的法律祖先。

items.example: Proxy is the clipped modern form.
items.exampleCN: proxy 是缩略后的现代形式。

items.meaning: an official who manages for another
items.example: Procurator keeps the -or agent ending.
items.exampleCN: procurator 保留了 -or 施事词尾。

items.example: The suffix -ator forms procurator.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ator 构成 procurator。

items.example: The ending -ion forms procuration.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ion 构成 procuration。

items.example: Procuration remains a legal term today.
items.exampleCN: procuration 如今仍是法律术语。

items.example: Procure shifted from managing to obtaining.
items.exampleCN: procure 的词义从「代管」转向了「获取」。

latinEntries.meaning: to take care of for another

definition_zh: 谨慎的；审慎的；有先见之明的；（金融、监管用语）审慎的、防范风险的；顾问性的
definition_en: acting with care for the future, avoiding unnecessary risk, especially in finance and regulation
core_image: 一位老会计在签字前反复核对账本，把未来可能出的错都先算进去
scene: 新基金成立前，董事们把最坏的情况逐一算了一遍才敢签约。The letters of agreement were approved on strictly prudential grounds.
sceneCN: 这里 prudential 是「审慎的、防范风险的」（第 1 个义项：做事考虑长远、规避不必要的风险）；句意为协议是在严格的审慎原则下获得批准的，强调先看清风险再行动。

pos.zh: 审慎的；谨慎的；防范风险的

collocations.zh: 审慎的理由；策略上的理由

derivatives.zh: 由 prudent 加名词后缀 -ence 构成，义为「审慎；谨慎；先见」
prudential 的同根基本形容词，义为「谨慎的；精明的」
由 prudent 加 -ly 构成，义为「审慎地」

senses.title: Acting with foresight and care
senses.definition: guided by careful thought about what may happen in the future
senses.definitionCN: 出于对未来可能发生之事的周密考虑而行事
senses.example: She took a prudential second look at the contract before signing.
senses.exampleCN: 签字前，她出于审慎又看了一遍合同。
senses.why: The root means seeing ahead, so prudential action is action that looks past the present moment.
senses.whyCN: 词根意思是「向前看」，所以审慎的行为就是越过眼前、看到将来的行为。

senses.title: Cautious in practical affairs
senses.definition: showing caution in money, work or everyday decisions
senses.definitionCN: 在金钱、工作或日常决定中表现出小心谨慎
senses.example: His prudential habits kept the family out of debt.
senses.exampleCN: 他谨慎的习惯让这个家没有负债。
senses.why: Seeing ahead turns into ordinary caution once the word is applied to daily life.
senses.whyCN: 当这个词用于日常生活，「向前看」就变成了普通的谨慎。

senses.title: Avoiding needless risk
senses.definition: designed to keep danger and loss as small as possible
senses.definitionCN: 旨在把危险和损失压到最低
senses.example: The firm keeps a prudential reserve for sudden losses.
senses.exampleCN: 公司保留一笔防风险的准备金，以应对突发损失。
senses.why: A person who looks ahead also keeps a buffer, so the word comes to name risk control.
senses.whyCN: 会向前看的人也会留出缓冲，于是这个词引申为风险控制。

senses.title: Financial and regulatory prudence
senses.titleCN: 审慎监管的；（金融）稳健经营的
senses.definition: relating to rules that force banks and insurers to work safely
senses.definitionCN: 指迫使银行和保险公司安全经营的规则
senses.example: New prudential standards require banks to hold more capital.
senses.exampleCN: 新的审慎监管标准要求银行持有更多资本。
senses.why: Banks need a legal version of looking ahead, and this sense names the rules that do it.
senses.whyCN: 银行需要一种制度化的「向前看」，这个义项就指实现它的规则。

senses.title: For prudential reasons
senses.definition: in a phrase naming a motive based on caution rather than duty
senses.definitionCN: 用于短语，表示动机出于谨慎而非义务
senses.example: He stayed silent for prudential reasons, not out of loyalty.
senses.exampleCN: 他沉默是出于审慎的考虑，而不是忠诚。
senses.why: The adjective often marks the reason behind an act, and this sense isolates that use.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词常用来标注行为背后的理由，此义项专指这种用法。

senses.title: Concerned with public welfare
senses.definition: in old use, relating to welfare or to a wise policy for the public
senses.definitionCN: 旧用法中指与福利或明智公共政策相关的
senses.example: The old treatise spoke of a prudential duty to the poor.
senses.exampleCN: 那部旧论文提到对穷人的一种关乎福利的责任。
senses.why: Wise foresight applied to a whole town became a word for welfare and sound policy.
senses.whyCN: 把明智的先见用到整个城镇上，这个词就带上了福利与善政的色彩。

senses.title: Advisory or supervisory
senses.definition: in rare use, serving as a body that advises or oversees
senses.definitionCN: 罕见用法，指担任提供建议或监督职责的机构
senses.example: A prudential committee reviewed the plan first.
senses.exampleCN: 一个顾问委员会先审阅了这份计划。
senses.why: A council that sees ahead for others is an advisory council, and the word follows that path.
senses.whyCN: 替他人向前看的议事会就是顾问议事会，这个词沿着这条路延伸出此义。

senses.title: A matter needing prudence
senses.definition: in rare plural use, an affair that calls for careful judgment
senses.definitionCN: 罕见的复数用法，指需要小心判断的事务
senses.example: Such matters are prudentials rather than matters of law.
senses.exampleCN: 这类事属于需审慎权衡的事，而非法律问题。
senses.why: The abstract quality is turned into a countable thing, so a need for care becomes a matter.
senses.whyCN: 抽象品质被变成可数之物，于是「需要谨慎」就成了一件具体的事。

intro.en: Prudential comes from Latin prudentia, foreseeing or practical wisdom, via prudent and the suffix -ial.
intro.cn: prudential 来自拉丁语 prudentia（先见、实践智慧），经由 prudent 加上后缀 -ial 构成。

items.en: Providere means to see ahead or provide for the future, and prudentia is the habit of doing so.
items.cn: providere 意为向前看、为将来预备，prudentia 就是这样做事的习惯。

items.en: Prudentia is treated as one of the cardinal virtues, pairing foresight with good judgment.
items.cn: prudentia 被列为四枢德之一，把先见与良好判断放在一起。

items.en: Prudent passes into French with the general sense of wise and careful.
items.cn: prudent 进入法语，带上了明智、小心的普通含义。

items.en: Prudent enters English, and prudential is formed from it with the suffix -ial.
items.cn: prudent 进入英语，再由它加后缀 -ial 构成 prudential。

items.en: The word takes on the new technical sense of financial risk control, as in prudential regulation.
items.cn: 这个词获得金融风险控制的新技术义，如审慎监管。

note.en: Prudential sits in the prudent family and is close to words for caution and for wise planning.
note.cn: prudential 属于 prudent 词族，与表示谨慎和明智筹划的词关系密切。

entries.definition: careful and wise about the future
entries.definitionCN: 谨慎明智的；有远虑的

entries.definition: careful good judgment
entries.definitionCN: 审慎；远虑

entries.definition: in a cautious and wise way
entries.definitionCN: 审慎地；谨慎地

entries.definition: avoiding danger or mistakes
entries.definitionCN: 小心的；谨慎的

entries.definition: thinking carefully before acting
entries.definitionCN: 慎重的；考虑周到的

entries.definition: planning for future needs
entries.definitionCN: 有远见的；节俭预备的

normalIntro.en: Prudential is the adjective of looking ahead: you act now because you can already see tomorrow.
normalIntro.cn: prudential 是「向前看」的形容词：你现在这样做，是因为已经看到了明天。

normal.en: The -ial ending turns prudent into prudential, just as part becomes partial.
normal.cn: 词尾 -ial 把 prudent 变成 prudential，就像 part 变成 partial。

normal.en: Prudential reasons are reasons of caution, not of right and wrong.
normal.cn: prudential reasons 指的是出于谨慎、而非是非对错的理由。

normal.en: In banking, prudential rules are the safety rules that keep banks from collapsing.
normal.cn: 在银行业，审慎规则就是防止银行倒闭的安全规则。

normal.en: Compare prudent and prudential: prudent describes a person, prudential often describes a reason or a rule.
normal.cn: 对比 prudent 与 prudential：prudent 多形容人，prudential 多形容理由或规则。

normal.en: The family of prudence, prudent and prudential all share one core of foresight.
normal.cn: prudence、prudent、prudential 都共享「先见」这一个核心。

abstract.en: Picture an accountant with a lamp, checking the ledger one more time before the signature.
abstract.cn: 想象一位会计打着灯，在签字前又把账本核对了一遍。

abstract.en: Imagine a sailor tying down the cargo though the sky is still clear.
abstract.cn: 想象水手在天还晴着的时候就把货物捆紧。

abstract.en: Think of a bank that keeps a hidden cushion of money for a bad year.
abstract.cn: 想象一家银行悄悄地留着一笔钱，用来应对坏年景。

examples.en: The decision was taken for prudential rather than moral reasons.
examples.cn: 作出这个决定出于审慎，而不是道德理由。

examples.en: Prudential regulation is meant to protect savers when a bank fails.
examples.cn: 审慎监管旨在银行倒闭时保护储户。

examples.en: A prudential investor keeps cash on hand for sudden falls in the market.
examples.cn: 审慎的投资者会留出现金，以备市场突然下跌。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「普鲁登小姐」出门总要带伞——prudential 就是这种先看天、再出门的审慎；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 providere（向前看、预备）→ prudentia（先见、实践智慧）→ 法语 prudent → 英语 prudent → prudential，核心义「先看到将来，再决定现在」。

sensesIntro.en: Prudential starts as the adjective of foresight, narrows to everyday caution, then to risk control, formal rules, and finally to old uses of welfare and advice.
sensesIntro.cn: prudential 起初是表示「先见」的形容词，先收窄为日常的谨慎，再延伸到风险控制与正式规则，最后剩下表示福利与顾问的旧义。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an accountant who checks the ledger again before signing.
core.cn: 核心意象：签字前又把账本核对一遍的会计。

branches.en: Foresight is the first sense and the heart of the word.
branches.cn: 先见是首要义项，也是这个词的核心。

branches.en: Everyday caution is the practical branch.
branches.cn: 日常谨慎是其实践分支。

branches.en: Risk control hands the habit to banks and regulators.
branches.cn: 风险控制把这种习惯交给了银行与监管者。

branches.en: Naming a reason as prudential marks a motive of caution.
branches.cn: 把理由称为审慎，就是标注一种谨慎的动机。

branches.en: Old welfare and advisory uses keep the same idea at the level of policy.
branches.cn: 旧的福利与顾问义保持同样的思路，只是放在政策层面。

intro.en: Prudential is built on prudent with the adjective suffix -ial, and the family rests on Latin prudentia.
intro.cn: prudential 由 prudent 加形容词后缀 -ial 构成，整个词族根植于拉丁语 prudentia。

latinIntro.en: Latin prudentia means foresight and practical wisdom, formed from pro and videre.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 prudentia 意为先见与实践智慧，由 pro 与 videre 构成。

items.example: The prefix pro- adds the idea of looking forward.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 pro- 带来「向前看」的意思。

items.example: Videre supplies the seeing in foresight.
items.exampleCN: videre 提供了「先见」中的「见」。

items.example: Prudentia gives the word its core of judgment.
items.exampleCN: prudentia 赋予这个词判断力的内核。

items.example: Prudent is the base of the family.
items.exampleCN: prudent 是这一词族的基础词。

items.example: The suffix -ial forms prudential.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ial 构成 prudential。

items.example: The suffix -ence forms prudence.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ence 构成 prudence。

items.example: Prudence names the quality itself.
items.exampleCN: prudence 指这种品质本身。

items.example: Provident shares the seeing-ahead root.
items.exampleCN: provident 共享「向前看」的词根。

items.example: The negative prefix in- gives imprudent.
items.exampleCN: 否定前缀 in- 构成 imprudent。

definition_zh: 精神病学的；精神病的；精神治疗方面的
definition_en: relating to the study and medical treatment of mental illness
core_image: 一间安静的诊室：医生坐在桌后，仔细听人讲述心里的风暴
scene: 一位年轻患者第一次走进医院的心理科，诊室外走廊很安静。The young man was referred for psychiatric assessment after weeks of sleepless nights.
sceneCN: 这里 psychiatric 是「精神科的、与精神疾病诊疗有关的」（第 1 个义项：与精神病学相关的）；句意为这名年轻男子连续几周失眠后被转诊接受精神科评估，强调词语落在医学诊疗语境中。

pos.zh: 形容词：精神病学的；精神病的

collocations.zh: 精神科护理；精神卫生照护

derivatives.zh: 由希腊语词根 iatreia（医术）构成，义为「精神病学」
由 psychiatry 加 -ist 构成，义为「精神科医生」
由本词加 -ally 构成，义为「从精神医学角度」

senses.title: Relating to psychiatry
senses.definition: connected with the branch of medicine that studies and treats mental illness
senses.definitionCN: 与研究和治疗精神疾病的医学分支有关的
senses.example: She works in the psychiatric department of a teaching hospital.
senses.exampleCN: 她在一家教学医院的精神科工作。
senses.why: The suffix ties the word to psychiatry, so the first sense simply points at that field.
senses.whyCN: 后缀把词绑定在 psychiatry 上，所以第一义项就是「指向这一学科」。

senses.title: Caused by or showing mental illness
senses.definition: arising from or showing symptoms of a mental disorder
senses.definitionCN: 由精神障碍引起或表现出其症状的
senses.example: He suffered a psychiatric episode after months without sleep.
senses.exampleCN: 连续几个月失眠后，他出现了一次精神疾病发作。
senses.why: Once the word marks a field, it can also mark the illness that belongs to that field.
senses.whyCN: 一旦这个词标注了某个领域，它也能标注属于该领域的疾病。

senses.title: Specialist care settings
senses.definition: describing hospitals, units and services that treat mental illness
senses.definitionCN: 描述收治精神疾病病人的医院、病房和服务
senses.example: The numbers of people waiting for a psychiatric bed keep rising.
senses.exampleCN: 等待精神科病床的人数持续上升。
senses.why: Where there are doctors there are also wards, so the adjective names the places of care.
senses.whyCN: 有医生就有病房，于是这个形容词也用来命名照护的场所。

senses.title: Old use for treatment of nerves
senses.definition: in older texts, relating to medicine for the nerves or the mind
senses.definitionCN: 在较旧文本中，指与神经或心理治疗相关的
senses.example: An old manual lists psychiatric remedies for melancholy.
senses.exampleCN: 一本旧手册列有治疗忧郁症的精神类药方。
senses.why: Early medicine used a broader idea of nerves, and the word kept that older reach.
senses.whyCN: 早期医学对神经的理解更宽，这个词保留了这种较宽的用法。

senses.title: Nervous, from mild stress
senses.definition: in informal talk, jokingly used for behaviour caused by stress
senses.definitionCN: 口语中戏谑地形容因压力而产生的一惊一乍行为
senses.example: His habit of checking the lock three times looks almost psychiatric.
senses.exampleCN: 他反复检查门锁的习惯看起来几乎有点神经过敏。
senses.why: People borrow clinical words for everyday stress, and this is the playful sense.
senses.whyCN: 人们常把临床词借到日常压力上，这就是那个戏谑的义项。

senses.title: Under psychiatric examination
senses.definition: used of a person or case placed under medical review of the mind
senses.definitionCN: 指一个人或案件被置于精神医学的检视之下
senses.example: The defendant was sent for psychiatric examination.
senses.exampleCN: 被告被送去接受精神医学检查。
senses.why: Courts need a neutral term for a mental review, so the adjective marks the people involved in it.
senses.whyCN: 法庭需要一个中性的词来描述心理审查，这个形容词就标注了参与其中的人。

senses.title: Side effects from drugs
senses.definition: describing symptoms produced by medicines used in mental treatment
senses.definitionCN: 描述精神治疗所用药物引起的症状
senses.example: Doctors watched for psychiatric side effects of the drug.
senses.exampleCN: 医生密切留意这种药引起的精神方面的副作用。
senses.why: Treatment has its own risks, and the word extends from doctors to the medicines they give.
senses.whyCN: 治疗本身也会带来风险，这个词便从医生延伸到医生开的药。

senses.title: Statistical: mental health data
senses.titleCN: 统计意义上的精神科数据
senses.definition: used for counts and records of mental illness in public health
senses.definitionCN: 用于公共卫生中精神疾病的计数与登记
senses.example: The survey collects psychiatric admissions by region.
senses.exampleCN: 这项调查按地区收集精神科收治数据。
senses.why: Public health turns individual cases into numbers, and the adjective moves into the table.
senses.whyCN: 公共卫生把个体病例变成数字，这个形容词就进入了表格。

intro.en: Psychiatric joins the Greek root psych-, meaning soul or mind, with iatrikos, meaning healing or medical.
intro.cn: psychiatric 把希腊词根 psych-（灵魂、心灵）与 iatrikos（医术的、治疗的）合在一起。

items.en: Psykhe means breath and soul, and iatros means healer.
items.cn: psykhe 意为气息与灵魂，iatros 意为医者。

items.en: Iatrikos, from iatros, means belonging to healing or medicine.
items.cn: iatrikos 来自 iatros，意为与治疗、医术有关的。

items.en: The learned compound psychiatria combines the two roots for the healing of the mind.
items.cn: 学术复合词 psychiatria 把两个词根合起来，指对心灵的医治。

items.en: Psychiatrie is coined from the same elements and spreads through European medicine.
items.cn: Psychiatrie 由同样的成分构成，并在欧洲医学界传播开来。

items.en: Psychiatry enters English, and psychiatric follows as its adjective with the Greek ending -ikos.
items.cn: psychiatry 进入英语，psychiatric 随后作为其形容词出现，带希腊词尾 -ikos。

items.en: Psychiatric spreads from institutions to law, social policy and statistics.
items.cn: psychiatric 从机构用语扩展到法律、社会政策与统计领域。

note.en: Psychiatric is the adjective of psychiatry and belongs with words for mental illness and its treatment.
note.cn: psychiatric 是 psychiatry 的形容词，与表示精神疾病及其治疗的词同处一个义场。

entries.definition: the medical study of mental illness
entries.definitionCN: 精神病学

entries.definition: a doctor of psychiatry
entries.definitionCN: 精神科医生

entries.definition: a severe mental disorder
entries.definitionCN: 精神病；精神病性障碍

entries.definition: relating to the mind or behaviour
entries.definitionCN: 心理的；心理学的

entries.definition: relating to the nervous system
entries.definitionCN: 神经系统的；神经学的

entries.definition: relating to the mind
entries.definitionCN: 精神的；心理的

normalIntro.en: Psychiatric is the adjective of psychiatry: mind plus healing, turned into a describing word.
normalIntro.cn: psychiatric 是 psychiatry 的形容词：心灵加医治，再变成修饰用的词。

normal.en: Psych- means mind, as in psychology and psychic.
normal.cn: psych- 表示「心灵」，见于 psychology 和 psychic。

normal.en: The iatr- part shares a root with iatrogenic, meaning caused by medical treatment.
normal.cn: iatr- 部分与 iatrogenic（由医疗引起的）共享词根。

normal.en: Psychiatric ward, psychiatric hospital and psychiatric care are the most common partners.
normal.cn: psychiatric ward、psychiatric hospital 和 psychiatric care 是最常见的搭配。

normal.en: The noun is psychiatry and the person is a psychiatrist.
normal.cn: 名词是 psychiatry，从业者则是 psychiatrist。

normal.en: Compare psychological and psychiatric: psychological is broader, while psychiatric is medical and clinical.
normal.cn: 对比 psychological 与 psychiatric：psychological 范围更宽，psychiatric 更偏医学与临床。

abstract.en: Picture a quiet office with two chairs, a notebook and a lamp, rather than a busy ward.
abstract.cn: 想象一间安静的诊室，只有两张椅子、一本笔记和一盏灯，而不是忙碌的病房。

abstract.en: Imagine a doctor who treats the mind the way a heart doctor treats the heart.
abstract.cn: 想象一位医生，用治心脏的方式去医治心灵。

abstract.en: Think of a record sheet where a whole life is summed up as an admission.
abstract.cn: 想象一张登记表，把一整段人生浓缩成一次入院记录。

examples.en: Psychiatric services in the region have been cut for years.
examples.cn: 该地区的精神科服务多年来不断被削减。

examples.en: The judge ordered a psychiatric report before the trial.
examples.cn: 法官在庭审前下令出具一份精神医学报告。

examples.en: Many psychiatric conditions can be treated effectively today.
examples.cn: 如今许多精神疾病都能得到有效治疗。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「赛凯特里克」——赛场上紧张到心跳失控就去看精神科；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 希腊语 psykhe（气息、灵魂）+ iatros（医者）、iatrikos（医术的）→ 学术拉丁语 psychiatria → 英语 psychiatry → 形容词 psychiatric，核心义「医治心灵的医术」。

sensesIntro.en: Psychiatric begins as the adjective of psychiatry, then extends to the illnesses, the places of care, and finally to formal, playful and statistical uses.
sensesIntro.cn: psychiatric 起初是 psychiatry 的形容词，随后扩展到疾病本身、照护场所，最后延伸到正式、戏谑和统计的用法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a quiet consultation room where the mind is examined like a body.
core.cn: 核心意象：一间安静的诊室，心灵像身体一样被检查。

branches.en: Pointing at the field is the basic sense.
branches.cn: 指向这一学科是基本义项。

branches.en: Illness is the object the field treats.
branches.cn: 疾病是这一学科治疗的对象。

branches.en: Places of care and examinations are the institutional side.
branches.cn: 照护场所与检查属于制度层面。

branches.en: Early nerves medicine and drug effects show the clinical reach.
branches.cn: 早期神经医学与药物效应体现了临床的延伸。

branches.en: Playful stress talk and statistics are the everyday and public ends.
branches.cn: 戏谑的压力说法与统计分别是日常和公共的两端。

intro.en: Psychiatric joins the Greek roots psych- and iatr- with the Greek adjective ending -ic.
intro.cn: psychiatric 由希腊词根 psych-、iatr- 与希腊形容词词尾 -ic 组成。

latinIntro.en: The word is Greek at heart, carried into English through Latin and German medical terms.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词本源于希腊语，经由拉丁语和德语医学术语传入英语。

items.example: The root psych- appears in psychology.
items.exampleCN: 词根 psych- 出现在 psychology 中。

items.example: The element -iatry appears in psychiatry and geriatry.
items.exampleCN: 成分 -iatry 见于 psychiatry 与老年医学等词中。

items.example: Iatros is the source of the healing root.
items.exampleCN: iatros 是「医治」词根的来源。

items.example: Psychiatry is the noun behind the adjective.
items.exampleCN: psychiatry 是这一形容词背后的名词。

items.example: The suffix -ic forms psychiatric.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ic 构成 psychiatric。

items.example: The suffix -ist forms psychiatrist.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ist 构成 psychiatrist。

items.example: Psychology shares the psych- root.
items.exampleCN: psychology 共享 psych- 词根。

items.example: Iatrogenic shares the iatr- root.
items.exampleCN: iatrogenic 共享 iatr- 词根。

items.example: Psychotic is a clinical neighbour.
items.exampleCN: psychotic 是临床上的邻近词。

definition_zh: 精神科医生；精神病学家
definition_en: a doctor who specialises in diagnosing and treating mental illness
core_image: 一位穿白大褂的医生，在安静的房间里耐心听人讲述心里的困扰
scene: 夜里急诊很忙，护士把一位情绪失控的病人带到诊室，等医生来评估。The psychiatrist listened for an hour before suggesting a treatment plan.
sceneCN: 这里 psychiatrist 是「精神科医生」（第 1 个义项：专门诊治精神疾病的人）；句意为这位医生先听病人讲了一个小时，才提出治疗方案，强调先倾听再判断的职业特点。

pos.zh: 名词：精神科医生；精神病学家

collocations.zh: 精神科医生与心理学家

collocations.phrase: under the care of a psychiatrist
collocations.zh: 在精神科医生的照料下

derivatives.zh: 由精神病学词根构成，义为「精神病学」
由 psychiatry 加 -ic 构成，义为「精神科（学）的」
由 psychiatric 加 -ally 构成，义为「从精神医学角度」

senses.title: A doctor of mental illness
senses.definition: a medical doctor who diagnoses and treats mental disorders
senses.definitionCN: 诊断并治疗精神障碍的医学医生
senses.example: Her psychiatrist changed the dose after the first month.
senses.exampleCN: 她的精神科医生在第一月后调整了剂量。
senses.why: The -ist ending marks the person who practises the healing of the mind, so the core sense is the practitioner.
senses.whyCN: 词尾 -ist 标注从事「医治心灵」这一行业的人，所以核心义项就是从业者。

senses.title: A specialist in psychiatry
senses.definition: a specialist qualified in the medical study of the mind
senses.definitionCN: 取得精神医学研究资格的专家
senses.example: The psychiatrist published a paper on adult anxiety.
senses.exampleCN: 这位精神医学专家发表了一篇关于成年人焦虑的论文。
senses.why: The same person can be seen as a scholar of the field, not only as a clinician.
senses.whyCN: 同一个人也可以被看作这一学科的研究者，而不只是临床医生。

senses.title: Prescriber of medicines
senses.definition: a doctor who may prescribe drugs for mental conditions
senses.definitionCN: 可以为精神疾病开具药物的医生
senses.example: Only a psychiatrist can prescribe that medicine here.
senses.exampleCN: 在这里只有精神科医生能开那种药。
senses.why: Medical training gives the right to prescribe, and this is what separates the role from other helpers.
senses.whyCN: 医学训练带来了处方权，这正是这个角色与其他帮助者的分界。

senses.title: Legal expert witness
senses.definition: a psychiatrist who advises courts on a person mental state
senses.definitionCN: 向法庭提供当事人精神状态意见的精神科医生
senses.example: A psychiatrist told the court the defendant was fit to stand trial.
senses.exampleCN: 一位精神科医生告诉法庭被告适合受审。
senses.why: Courts call on the expert when guilt depends on the state of a mind.
senses.whyCN: 当罪责取决于一个人的心理状态时，法庭就会请这位专家出场。

senses.title: Researcher in psychiatry
senses.titleCN: 从事精神医学研究的学者
senses.definition: a scientist trained as a psychiatrist who studies the brain and behaviour
senses.definitionCN: 受过精神科训练、研究大脑与行为的研究者
senses.example: Laboratory psychiatrists are testing a new kind of scan.
senses.exampleCN: 实验室里的精神医学研究者正在测试一种新的扫描方式。
senses.why: The clinic produces questions that only research can answer, and the word follows them into the lab.
senses.whyCN: 临床产生的疑问只有研究才能回答，这个词便随之走进实验室。

senses.title: Informal: someone who analyses you
senses.titleCN: 口语：爱分析别人心思的人
senses.definition: in joking use, a person who keeps explaining other people motives
senses.definitionCN: 戏谑用法，指总爱剖析别人动机的人
senses.example: Stop being my psychiatrist and just say what you think.
senses.exampleCN: 别当我的心理医生了，直说你的想法吧。
senses.why: People borrow the profession as a tease, so the word can name an amateur mind-reader.
senses.whyCN: 人们把这一职业借来开玩笑，于是这个词也能指业余的「读心者」。

senses.title: Historical asylum physician
senses.titleCN: 历史上精神病院的医生
senses.definition: in old records, the doctor in charge of an asylum
senses.definitionCN: 在旧记录中，指负责管理精神病院的医生
senses.example: Asylum psychiatrists kept detailed case books in that century.
senses.exampleCN: 那个世纪的精神病院医生留下了详细的病历簿。
senses.why: Before modern clinics there were asylums, and the title of their doctors carries that history.
senses.whyCN: 现代诊所之前是精神病院，那里医生的头衔承载着这段历史。

senses.title: Psychiatrist versus psychologist
senses.titleCN: 与心理学家相区别的医者
senses.definition: used when a contrast is drawn with a psychologist, who cannot prescribe
senses.definitionCN: 用于与心理学家对照时，后者不能开药
senses.example: She saw a psychologist first, then a psychiatrist for medication.
senses.exampleCN: 她先找了心理学家，之后又找精神科医生开药。
senses.why: The word often appears in pairs to draw the medical line, and that contrast is itself a sense in use.
senses.whyCN: 这个词常成对出现，用来划出医学界线，这种对照本身就是一种在用的含义。

intro.en: Psychiatrist joins the Greek root psych-, meaning soul or mind, with iatros, a healer, and the person suffix -ist.
intro.cn: psychiatrist 把希腊词根 psych-（心灵）、iatros（医者）与人称后缀 -ist 组合起来。

items.en: Psykhe means breath and soul, and iatros means healer.
items.cn: psykhe 意为气息与灵魂，iatros 意为医者。

items.en: Psykhiatreia is recorded for the healing of souls, though it is rare.
items.cn: psykhiatreia 见于记载，指医治灵魂，但很罕见。

items.en: Psychiater is coined in German medicine, and psychiatrie names the new field.
items.cn: Psychiater 在德语医学中被造出，psychiatrie 则为这一新领域命名。

items.en: Psychiatrist appears in English medical writing in the early part of the century and becomes common by its end.
items.cn: psychiatrist 在本世纪初出现在英语医学写作中，到世纪末已很常见。

items.en: The title spreads from asylums into general hospitals, courts and popular speech.
items.cn: 这个称谓从精神病院扩散到综合医院、法庭与大众口语。

note.en: Psychiatrist names a person in the psychiatry family and is close to other helpers of the mind.
note.cn: psychiatrist 在 psychiatry 词族中指人，与其它心理和治疗的帮助者相近。

entries.definition: the medical study of mental illness
entries.definitionCN: 精神病学

entries.definition: relating to psychiatry
entries.definitionCN: 精神病学的；精神科的

entries.definition: a person who treats the mind by talking
entries.definitionCN: 用谈话方式治疗心理问题的人

entries.definition: an expert in psychology who usually cannot prescribe
entries.definitionCN: 心理学家，通常不能开药

entries.definition: a doctor of general medicine
entries.definitionCN: 内科医生；医师

entries.definition: a psychoanalyst who treats patients by analysis
entries.definitionCN: 精神分析师

normalIntro.en: Psychiatrist is the person born from psychiatry: mind, healing and the one who does it.
normalIntro.cn: psychiatrist 是从 psychiatry 里走出来的人：心灵、医治，以及做这件事的人。

normal.en: Drop the -ist and you get psychiatry, then add -ic for psychiatric.
normal.cn: 去掉 -ist 得到 psychiatry，再加 -ic 就是 psychiatric。

normal.en: A psychiatrist is a medical doctor, so the word hides the doctor it really is.
normal.cn: psychiatrist 是医学医生，这个词其实藏着「医生」的身份。

normal.en: The -ist ending works like it does in dentist and pharmacist, both people who treat you.
normal.cn: 词尾 -ist 的用法同 dentist、pharmacist，都是给你看病给药的人。

normal.en: Compare psychiatrist and psychologist: the psychiatrist can prescribe medicine, the psychologist usually cannot.
normal.cn: 对比 psychiatrist 与 psychologist：前者能开药，后者通常不能。

normal.en: See a psychiatrist and consult a psychiatrist are the everyday phrasing.
normal.cn: see a psychiatrist 与 consult a psychiatrist 是日常说法。

abstract.en: Picture a white coat in a soft chair, notebook open, saying nothing for a long while.
abstract.cn: 想象一件白大褂坐在软椅上，笔记本摊开，很久都不说话。

abstract.en: Imagine a key over a medicine cabinet that only this doctor can open.
abstract.cn: 想象药柜上的一把钥匙，只有这位医生能打开。

abstract.en: Think of a courtroom where the one with the scalpel-free title carries the most weight.
abstract.cn: 想象一间法庭，这位不动手术刀的头衔却最有分量。

examples.en: Psychiatrists are in short supply in rural areas.
examples.cn: 农村地区严重缺乏精神科医生。

examples.en: The psychiatrist asked him to come back in two weeks.
examples.cn: 精神科医生让他两周后再来。

examples.en: He trained as a psychiatrist before moving into research.
examples.cn: 他在转做研究之前接受的是精神科医生训练。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「赛凯特瑞斯特」——在紧张到心跳加速的赛场上，凯特想找一位心理医生聊聊；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 希腊语 psykhe（气息、灵魂）+ iatros（医者）→ 德语 Psychiater、英语 psychiatry → 英语 psychiatrist（加人称后缀 -ist），核心义「医治心灵的医者」。

sensesIntro.en: Psychiatrist first names the treating doctor, then the specialist, the prescriber and the legal witness, and finally the playful and historical uses.
sensesIntro.cn: psychiatrist 先指诊治的医生，再指专家、开药者与法医证人，最后延伸到戏称与历史用法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a doctor in a white coat who listens before deciding.
core.cn: 核心意象：穿白大褂、先倾听再判断的医生。

branches.en: The treating doctor is the central sense.
branches.cn: 诊治医生是中心义项。

branches.en: Specialist and researcher are the scholarly sides of the same title.
branches.cn: 专家与研究者是同一头衔的学术一面。

branches.en: The power to prescribe is what marks the medical line.
branches.cn: 处方权划出了医学的界线。

branches.en: Courts and old asylums are the institutional settings.
branches.cn: 法庭与旧日的精神病院是制度性的场景。

branches.en: The teasing use turns the profession into a comic habit.
branches.cn: 戏谑用法把这一职业变成了滑稽的习惯。

intro.en: Psychiatrist builds on psych- and iatr- with the person ending -ist.
intro.cn: psychiatrist 由 psych-、iatr- 与人称词尾 -ist 构成。

latinIntro.en: The word is Greek in its roots and reached English through German and Latin medical terms.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词的词根来自希腊语，经由德语与拉丁语医学术语进入英语。

items.example: The root psych- appears in psychology.
items.exampleCN: 词根 psych- 出现在 psychology 中。

items.example: The root iatr- appears in iatrogenic.
items.exampleCN: 词根 iatr- 出现在 iatrogenic 中。

items.example: Iatros names the healer.
items.exampleCN: iatros 指医者。

items.example: The suffix -ist forms psychiatrist and dentist.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ist 构成 psychiatrist 与 dentist 等词。

items.example: Psychiatry is the practitioner field.
items.exampleCN: psychiatry 是医生所属的领域。

items.example: Psychiatric describes the field.
items.exampleCN: psychiatric 描述这一领域。

items.meaning: treatment of the mind by talking
items.example: Psychotherapy shares the psych- root and the healing idea.
items.exampleCN: psychotherapy 共享 psych- 词根与「医治」构想。

items.example: Psychology shares the psych- root.
items.exampleCN: psychology 共享 psych- 词根。

items.example: Psychologist shares the person ending -ist.
items.exampleCN: psychologist 共享人称词尾 -ist。

definition_zh: 精神病学；精神科（医学分支）
definition_en: the branch of medicine that deals with mental and emotional disorders and their treatment
core_image: 医生坐在安静的诊室里，用谈话与药物一起接住一颗摇摇欲坠的心
scene: 医院的走廊尽头有一间安静的诊室，桌上放着打开的病历夹，椅子上还留着上一位病人的余温。A young junior doctor chose psychiatry because she wanted to understand how the mind breaks and how it heals.
sceneCN: 这里 psychiatry 是「精神病学」（第 1 个义项：治疗精神与情绪障碍的医学分支）；句意：一位年轻的实习医生选择精神科，是因为她想弄懂心智如何崩坏、又如何被治愈。

pos.zh: 精神病学；精神科（作为医学分支）

derivatives.zh: 精神科医生：psychiatry 加职业后缀 -ist
精神病的；精神科的：-y 变为 -ic 构成的形容词
老年医学的：同样由 -iatry 的姊妹后缀 -iatrics 演化而来，表示医治某种对象
精神病理学的：psycho- 加 pathology 再加 -ical，指研究心理疾病的

senses.title: The medical specialty
senses.titleCN: 精神病学；精神科（学科名）
senses.definition: the branch of clinical medicine concerned with diagnosing, preventing, and treating mental disorders
senses.definitionCN: 以诊断、预防和治疗精神障碍为对象的临床医学分支
senses.example: Modern psychiatry draws on neurology, psychology, and pharmacology.
senses.exampleCN: 现代精神病学综合运用神经学、心理学和药理学。
senses.why: The Greek root iatros means healer, so psychiatry is literally the healing of the soul or mind.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语词根 iatros 意为「医者」，所以 psychiatry 字面上就是「医治心灵」，这决定了它首先是一门医学专科。

senses.title: Hospital psychiatric unit
senses.definition: the department or ward in a hospital where mental patients are assessed and treated
senses.definitionCN: 医院中评估与治疗精神病人的科室或病区
senses.example: She was admitted to psychiatry after the second panic attack.
senses.exampleCN: 第二次惊恐发作之后，她被收进了精神科。
senses.why: When a department takes the name of its discipline, the abstract field becomes a place you can be admitted to.
senses.whyCN: 当一个科室以学科命名时，抽象的学科名就变成了可以入院的地方，于是产生了「精神科」这一具体义。

senses.title: Professional practice of mental care
senses.definition: the professional work of psychiatrists in assessment, therapy, and medication management
senses.definitionCN: 精神科医生在评估、心理治疗与药物管理方面从事的专业工作
senses.example: Good psychiatry starts by listening before it prescribes.
senses.exampleCN: 好的精神科实践先从倾听开始，然后再开药。
senses.why: A discipline name often stands for the activity performed under it, the way law can mean the work of lawyers.
senses.whyCN: 学科名常常转指在该学科下进行的活动，就像 law 也可以指律师的工作，这就是「执业实践」义。

intro.en: Psychiatry joins Greek psyche, soul or breath, to Greek iatreia, healing, a formation built in the early nineteenth century on the model of words such as pediatrics.
intro.cn: psychiatry 由希腊语 psyche（灵魂、气息）与 iatreia（医治）拼合而成，一般认为形成于十九世纪初，仿照 pediatrics 一类词构成。

items.en: Psyche means soul, breath, or life, and iatros means healer.
items.cn: psyche 意为灵魂、气息或生命，iatros 意为医者。

items.en: Iatreia names the art or practice of healing.
items.cn: iatr eia 是希腊语 iatreia 的转写，指医治的技艺或实践。

items.en: German Psychiatrie is commonly credited with the new medical coinage; exact priority is uncertain.
items.cn: 一般认为德语 Psychiatrie 是这一新医学词的首创者，具体首创权尚有争议。

items.en: English psychiatry enters medical writing as madness is re-described as mental illness.
items.cn: 十九世纪中叶，psychiatry 进入英语医学文献，正好对应疯癫被重新描述为精神疾病的过程。

items.en: The word spreads from asylum medicine to university departments and general hospitals.
items.cn: 这个词随后从收容院医学扩展到大学本科系与综合医院。

note.en: Psychiatry is the medical treatment of mental illness, often confused with psychology, the study of mind and behaviour, and with psychoanalysis.
note.cn: psychiatry 是精神疾病的医学治疗，常与研究心理与行为的 psychology 以及精神分析 psychoanalysis 混淆。

entries.definition: a doctor who treats mental illness
entries.definitionCN: 精神科医生：psychiatry 加 -ist 表示从业者

entries.definition: relating to mental illness or its treatment
entries.definitionCN: 精神病的；精神治疗的：学科名的形容词形式

entries.definition: the scientific study of the mind and behaviour
entries.definitionCN: 心理学：同为 psyche 词根，但词尾 -logy 表示「学科研究」而不是「医治」，只是同根不同学科

entries.definition: the medical care of the feet
entries.definitionCN: 足病学：同样用 iatreia 词尾表示医治病痛部位，可对照记忆词尾含义

entries.definition: the study of the mind and behaviour, not necessarily medical
entries.definitionCN: 心理学：研究一般心理与行为的学科，通常不涉及处方权，与精神医学的执业边界不同

entries.definition: talk-based treatment of mental problems
entries.definitionCN: 心理治疗：以谈话为主要手段，是精神科治疗的一种方式

entries.definition: the branch of medicine dealing with the nervous system
entries.definitionCN: 神经病学：研究神经系统的医学分支，与精神科在脑与行为之间接壤

normalIntro.en: Split the word into psyche and iatreia, and you get the healing of the soul, which is the exact job of this medical specialty.
normalIntro.cn: 把词拆成 psyche 与 iatreia，就是「医治灵魂」，这正是这门医学专科的全部工作。

normal.en: The suffix -iatry appears in geriatrics and podiatry, each naming the healing of a particular kind of patient or body part.
normal.cn: 词尾 -iatry 也出现在 geriatrics 与 podiatry 中，每一例都表示「医治某类病人或某个身体部位」。

normal.en: A psychiatrist is one who practises psychiatry, so the -ist form names the doctor.
normal.cn: psychiatrist 是从事 psychiatry 的人，因此 -ist 形式指的就是医生。

normal.en: Psychiatric is the adjective, as in psychiatric hospital.
normal.cn: psychiatric 是它的形容词，例如 psychiatric hospital 表示精神病院。

normal.en: Do not shorten psychiatry to psyche when you mean the medical field.
normal.cn: 表示「精神医学这一领域」时不要缩写成 psyche，那是另一个词。

normal.en: Compare psychology, which studies the mind in general, while psychiatry treats mental disorders in clinics.
normal.cn: 对比 psychology：它研究一般意义上的心理，而 psychiatry 是在临床上治疗精神障碍。

abstract.en: Picture a physician who carries a prescription pad and a notebook of questions at the same time.
abstract.cn: 想象一位医生左手拿处方笺、右手拿问诊本，两种工具同时使用。

abstract.en: Imagine a hospital floor where the noise drops and the questions become very careful.
abstract.cn: 想象医院里的某一层，噪声骤然降低，每句问话都变得格外小心。

abstract.en: Think of a clinic visit that lasts an hour, because the patient has to feel understood before any medicine is chosen.
abstract.cn: 想象一次长达一小时的问诊，因为病人必须先感到被理解，才会选定用药。

examples.en: Psychiatry has moved steadily from custodial care to community-based treatment.
examples.cn: 精神病学已经从收容式照护稳步转向以社区为基础的治疗。

examples.en: He trained in psychiatry for five years before opening a private practice.
examples.cn: 他接受了五年精神科训练，之后才开设私人诊所。

examples.en: The new ward combines psychiatry with social work support.
examples.cn: 新病区把精神科治疗与社会工作支持结合起来。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「赛凯特瑞」——医生要「赛」过那些「凯」旋而归的心结，用「特」别的耐心「瑞」气把病治好；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 希腊语 psyche（灵魂、气息）+ iatreia（医治）→ 十九世纪初德语 Psychiatrie 与英语 psychiatry，核心义「医治心灵」。注意拼写时保留 psy- 与 -iatry 两段，不要与 psychiatry 的兄弟词 psychiatry 混淆。

sensesIntro.en: Psychiatry begins as the name of a medical specialty, then extends outward to the hospital unit that practises it and to the daily work of its doctors.
sensesIntro.cn: psychiatry 最初是一个医学专科的名称，随后向外延伸到开展该专科的医院科室，以及医生的日常执业活动。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a doctor who treats a broken mind in the same way another doctor treats a broken bone.
core.cn: 核心意象：像别的医生接骨那样，精神科医生去接住一颗破碎的心。

branches.en: The literal compound gives the name of the discipline.
branches.cn: 字面拼合直接给出了学科的名称。

branches.en: The place where the discipline is practised takes the same name.
branches.cn: 开展该学科的场所也沿用了同一个名字。

branches.en: The activity of the doctors is the most concrete extension.
branches.cn: 医生的执业活动是最落地的延伸义。

branches.en: A specialty and its ward always travel together in hospital language.
branches.cn: 在医院的语境里，专科与它的病区总是成对出现。

branches.en: The theory of the specialty and the work under it are two faces of one discipline.
branches.cn: 专科的理论与其下的实务是同一门学科的两面。

intro.en: Psychiatry is built from Greek psyche and iatreia, with English psychiatrist and psychiatric formed around it.
intro.cn: psychiatry 由希腊语 psyche 与 iatreia 拼成，英语围绕它构成 psychiatrist 与 psychiatric。

latinIntro.en: Latin renders psyche as anima and iatria as the art of healing, so the word is Greek rather than Latin in origin.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语把 psyche 译为 anima（灵魂），把 iatria 译为医治之艺；因此这个词的源语言是希腊语，而非拉丁语。

items.example: The combining form psycho- leads psychology and psychiatry.
items.exampleCN: 构词成分 psycho- 领起 psychology 与 psychiatry。

items.example: The suffix -iatry marks a branch of healing practice.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -iatry 标示一门医治实践的学科。

items.example: The suffix -ist turns psychiatry into psychiatrist.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ist 把 psychiatry 变成 psychiatrist。

items.example: The suffix -ic forms the adjective psychiatric.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ic 构成形容词 psychiatric。

items.example: The discipline name psychiatry carries the healing meaning.
items.exampleCN: 学科名 psychiatry 本身就带着「医治」义。

items.example: Psychiatric care is offered in the new unit.
items.exampleCN: 新病区提供精神科照护。

items.example: The psychiatrist reviewed the medication plan.
items.exampleCN: 精神科医生复核了用药方案。

items.example: Psychosomatic symptoms link stress to the body.
items.exampleCN: 心身症状把压力与身体联系起来。

items.example: Pediatrics was a model for coining psychiatry.
items.exampleCN: 儿科学是创造 psychiatry 一词时的模仿对象。

items.example: Geriatrics shares the same iatreia building block.
items.exampleCN: 老年医学共享与 iatreia 相同的构词板块。

definition_zh: 精神的；心灵的；通灵的；有超自然灵力的人
definition_en: relating to the mind or soul rather than the body, or involving powers that seem to go beyond the ordinary senses
core_image: 一个人的额前亮着一点微光，那光在不接触任何东西的情况下读到远处的心思
scene: 旧城区的街角有一间挂着珠帘的小店，门口写着看手相与牌阵的价格，屋里点着蜡烛，烤面包的焦香从后面的小厨房飘出来。A friend insisted that the woman at the back had been psychic for as long as anyone could remember.
sceneCN: 这里 psychic 是指人「有通灵能力的」（第 2 个义项：具有超自然感知的能力）；句意：一位朋友坚持说，店里最里面那位女士打从谁记得起就是通灵的。

pos.zh: 精神的；心灵的；通灵的
通灵者；有超自然灵力的人

derivatives.zh: 心灵；灵魂：psychic 所描述的对象本身
心灵的；精神的：psychic 加 -al 的旧式变体，多见于早期心理学文献
心灵学者：psychic 加 -ist，指研究心灵现象的人，现在较少使用
心理的：与 psychic 同出一源，但更强调心理过程而非超自然力量

senses.title: Relating to the mind
senses.definition: connected with the mind, especially with mental rather than physical energy
senses.definitionCN: 与心智相关的，尤其指精神力量而非身体力量
senses.example: Long hours of study take a psychic toll on students.
senses.exampleCN: 长时间的学习会在心理上消耗学生。
senses.why: The Greek source psychikos means of the soul or of life, so the earliest English sense simply points at the inner mind.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语源词 psychikos 意为「灵魂的、生命的」，所以最早进入英语的义项只是指向内在的心智。

senses.title: Having paranormal powers
senses.titleCN: 通灵的；有超自然能力的
senses.definition: said of a person who claims to sense events or thoughts without ordinary means
senses.definitionCN: 指某人声称无需寻常途径便能感知事件或想法
senses.example: She claims to be psychic and to sense things others cannot.
senses.exampleCN: 她自称能通灵，能够感知别人感知不到的东西。
senses.why: Nineteenth-century spiritualism attached the word to people who said they reached beyond the five senses, and that use stuck.
senses.whyCN: 十九世纪唯灵论把该词用在自称能超出五感的人身上，这一用法从此固定下来。

senses.title: A person with such powers
senses.definition: a person who claims or is believed to have such powers
senses.definitionCN: 声称或被相信拥有此类能力的人
senses.example: The psychic read her palm, then her cards.
senses.exampleCN: 那位通灵者先看她的手相，再看她的牌。
senses.why: English freely lets an adjective become a countable noun, so any adjective sense can name a person who bears it.
senses.whyCN: 英语常让形容词直接转作可数名词，于是形容词义项都能用来指具有该特征的人。

senses.title: Beyond physical explanation
senses.definition: relating to events that seem to fall outside what physics can explain
senses.definitionCN: 指看起来超出物理学所能解释的事件
senses.example: Researchers recorded several psychic events, none yet replicated.
senses.exampleCN: 研究者记录了几起超心理事件，但没有一起被重复验证。
senses.why: When the mind is thought to act without any physical channel, the word shifts from inner life to phenomena that seem to defy nature.
senses.whyCN: 当心智被认为可以不经任何物理通道而起作用时，这个词便从「内在生活」滑向「看似违背自然的现象」。

intro.en: Psychic comes from Greek psychikos, of the soul or of life, built on psyche, soul or breath, and it passed into English through Latin and the learned vocabulary of the seventeenth century.
intro.cn: psychic 来自希腊语 psychikos（灵魂的、生命的），由 psyche（灵魂、气息）构成，经过拉丁语与十七世纪的学术词汇进入英语。

items.en: Psyche means soul, breath, or life, and psychikos means belonging to the soul.
items.cn: psyche 意为灵魂、气息或生命，psychikos 意为属于灵魂的。

items.en: Latin philosophy uses anima for soul and mind, giving English a second route to the same idea.
items.cn: 拉丁语哲学用 anima 表示灵魂与心灵，为同一概念提供了进入英语的另一条路径。

items.en: Psychic enters English letters as a learned word for what belongs to the mind.
items.cn: 十七世纪，psychic 作为学术词进入英语，表示「属于心智的」。

items.en: Spiritualism and the Society for Psychical Research give the word its paranormal sense.
items.cn: 唯灵论与心灵研究会赋予这个词超自然的义项。

items.en: Everyday English keeps both the mental and the paranormal senses of the word.
items.cn: 现代英语同时保留了「心理的」与「超自然的」两个义项。

note.en: Psychic belongs to the psyche word family, but its meaning depends on whether the mind or the paranormal comes first.
note.cn: psychic 属于 psyche 词族，但它的意义取决于语境里突出的是「心智」还是「超自然」。

entries.definition: the human soul or mind
entries.definitionCN: 心灵：psychic 所修饰的核心名词

entries.definition: the study of the mind and behaviour
entries.definitionCN: 心理学：同根词，加上 -logy 表示学科

entries.definition: of the mind, often in old research contexts
entries.definitionCN: 心灵的：psychic 的 -al 变体，多见于早期研究文献

entries.definition: of the body or matter
entries.definitionCN: 身体的；物质的：与 psychic 只差几个字母，但 phy- 来自希腊语 physis（自然），只是拼写相近，词源毫无关系

entries.definition: knowing something without conscious reasoning
entries.definitionCN: 直觉的：不问缘由便知道，但不涉及超自然

entries.definition: reading or sending thoughts without speech
entries.definitionCN: 心灵感应的：特指隔着距离传递想法

entries.definition: outside what normal scientific laws explain
entries.definitionCN: 超自然的：比 psychic 更宽泛，包括灵异事件本身

normalIntro.en: Psychic is psyche with the Greek adjective ending -ikos, the same ending that gives English -ic in words such as magic and classic.
normalIntro.cn: psychic 是 psyche 加上希腊语形容词词尾 -ikos 而成的，该词尾在英语里写作 -ic，与 magic 的结尾同形。

normal.en: Psyche is the noun for the soul, so psychic keeps the inner-life core wherever it appears.
normal.cn: psyche 是表示灵魂的名词，所以 psychic 无论出现在哪里都保留「内在心灵」的内核。

normal.en: Psychic damage is mental harm, and psychic energy is mental energy, both in the first sense.
normal.cn: psychic damage 指心理伤害，psychic energy 指心理能量，两者都属第 1 个义项。

normal.en: Add -ist to get psychicist, though modern English mostly says a psychic for the person.
normal.cn: 加 -ist 可得 psychicist，但现代英语指那个人时更常说 a psychic。

normal.en: Watch the first three letters: psy- words point at the mind, phy- words point at nature.
normal.cn: 看开头三个字母：psy- 开头的词指向心智，phy- 开头的词指向自然。

normal.en: The formal adjective for general mental matters is usually psychological, while psychic carries a stronger flavour of the paranormal.
normal.cn: 一般心理话题的正式形容词通常是 psychological，而 psychic 更带有超自然的色彩。

abstract.en: Picture a forehead glowing in the dark, reading a room without touching it.
abstract.cn: 想象一颗在黑暗中发亮的额头，不用碰任何东西便读懂整个房间。

abstract.en: Imagine a tired mind that burns like a candle burning from both ends.
abstract.cn: 想象一颗疲惫的心，像两端同时燃烧的蜡烛。

abstract.en: Think of a hand held up over a person, sensing rather than feeling.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手悬在某人头顶，不是触摸，而是感应。

examples.en: The novel treats grief as a psychic wound that leaves physical scars.
examples.cn: 小说把悲伤当作一种会留下身体伤疤的心灵创伤。

examples.en: Sceptics tested the psychic under controlled conditions and found nothing.
examples.cn: 怀疑论者在受控条件下测试了那位通灵者，一无所获。

examples.en: She had a psychic dream about the accident before it happened.
examples.cn: 在事故发生之前，她做过一个关于这件事的通灵梦。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「赛奇」——通灵师「赛」得过所有人，全靠那点「奇」异的心电感应；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 希腊语 psyche（灵魂、气息）+ 形容词词尾 -ikos（英语作 -ic）→ psychikos → 拉丁语 → 英语 psychic，核心义「属于心灵的」；超自然义是十九世纪唯灵论附加的延伸。

sensesIntro.en: Psychic starts at the inward sense of the soul, then reaches out to people who claim powers beyond the senses, then to the person who has them, and finally to events that elude physical explanation.
sensesIntro.cn: psychic 从「属于灵魂」的内在义出发，再延伸到自称拥有超感能力的人，继而指拥有该能力的那个人，最后指无法用物理原理解释的事件。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a lit spot at the forehead that reads the world without touching it.
core.cn: 核心意象：额前亮着的一点微光，不触碰世界却能读到世界。

branches.en: The mental sense is the oldest and most neutral.
branches.cn: 心理义是最古老也最中立的义项。

branches.en: The paranormal ability sense grew with spiritualism.
branches.cn: 通灵能力义是随着唯灵论而长出来的。

branches.en: The noun for the person is the same adjective turned into a count noun.
branches.cn: 指人的名词义就是同一个形容词转为可数名词。

branches.en: Events beyond physics are the widest and most contested branch.
branches.cn: 超出物理法则的事件是最宽、也最有争议的分支。

branches.en: A psychic person and a psychic as a role differ mainly in grammar.
branches.cn: 「通灵的人」与「通灵者这一角色」的差别主要在于词法。

intro.en: Psychic is built from Greek psyche plus the adjective suffix -ikos, with psyche, psychical, and psychological as its nearest English relatives.
intro.cn: psychic 由希腊语 psyche 加形容词词尾 -ikos 构成，英语中最近的亲属是 psyche、psychical 与 psychological。

latinIntro.en: Latin uses anima and animus for the soul, so the Latin-family adjectives animistic and animal are the Latin-side cousins of the Greek word.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语用 anima 与 animus 表示灵魂，因此拉丁语一方最近的亲属是 animistic 与 animal 这类同形来源的词。

items.example: The combining form psych- begins psyche and psychic.
items.exampleCN: 构词成分 psych- 构成 psyche 与 psychic 的开头。

items.example: The suffix -ic makes an adjective out of a noun.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ic 把名词变成形容词。

items.example: Psyche is the noun behind psychic.
items.exampleCN: psyche 是 psychic 背后的名词。

items.example: Psychical research studied reported hauntings.
items.exampleCN: 心灵研究考察过据称的闹鬼事件。

items.meaning: of the mind in a scientific sense
items.example: Psychological support was offered after the fire.
items.exampleCN: 火灾之后提供了心理支持。

items.example: Psychosis needs immediate medical care.
items.exampleCN: 精神病需要立即的医疗照顾。

items.example: The suffix -logy forms psychology.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -logy 构成 psychology。

items.example: The suffix -ical forms psychological.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ical 构成 psychological。

items.example: The suffix -ist gives psychicist.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ist 构成 psychicist。

items.example: Psychosomatic illness shows mind on the body.
items.exampleCN: 心身疾病显示心智如何作用在身体上。

items.example: Telepathy names a claimed psychic power.
items.exampleCN: telepathy 指一种被声称拥有的通灵能力。

definition_zh: 翼龙；翼龙目动物
definition_en: any extinct flying reptile of the Mesozoic era, with a wing formed by a membrane stretched along an enormously long fourth finger
core_image: 一只皮膜翅膀的飞行动物掠过海边悬崖，翼尖由一根长得夸张的指骨撑开
scene: 博物馆的恐龙厅里，一具骨架被钢索吊在半空，翅膀展开比一辆汽车还宽，驻足抬头的人都不自觉屏住呼吸。The label explained that this pterosaur lived beside an inland sea and fed on fish.
sceneCN: 这里 pterosaur 是「翼龙」（第 1 个义项：中生代已灭绝的飞行爬行动物）；句意：标签上说明，这只翼龙生活在内陆海边，以鱼为食。

pos.zh: 翼龙；翼龙目动物

derivatives.zh: 翼手龙：翼龙目中的一个属名，因为词典常用，常被误当作所有翼龙的统称
无齿翼龙：翼龙目下著名的属名，头上长着长长的骨冠
蕨类植物：同为希腊语 pteron（羽、翅）词根，但指羽状叶，与翼龙只有词根关系

senses.title: The extinct flying reptile
senses.definition: any member of the order Pterosauria, flying reptiles that lived from the late Triassic to the end of the Cretaceous
senses.definitionCN: 翼龙目的任何成员，指三叠纪晚期到白垩纪末生活的飞行爬行动物
senses.example: The pterosaur was not a dinosaur, though both lived in the Mesozoic.
senses.exampleCN: 翼龙并不是恐龙，尽管两者都生活在中生代。
senses.why: Greek pteron means wing and sauros means lizard, so the word names a winged lizard from the moment it is coined.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 pteron 意为「翅膀」，sauros 意为「蜥蜴」，所以这个词一被造出就在字面上点明「长翅膀的蜥蜴」。

senses.title: A particular fossil specimen
senses.definition: a single fossil individual or species referred to by the general group name
senses.definitionCN: 以类群名泛指某一具化石个体或某个物种
senses.example: This pterosaur was found near a river bed in Brazil.
senses.exampleCN: 这具翼龙化石是在巴西一处河床附近发现的。
senses.why: Class names slide into count nouns easily, so you can say this pterosaur the way you say this bird.
senses.whyCN: 类群名很容易滑向可数名词，所以可以像说 this bird 那样说 this pterosaur，指某一个体。

senses.title: A model of the flying reptile
senses.titleCN: 翼龙的复原模型或形象
senses.definition: a reconstructed or depicted form of a pterosaur, as in a museum or film
senses.definitionCN: 博物馆或影视作品中复原、塑造出的翼龙形象
senses.example: The pterosaur in the film swept along a gorge with its wings folded.
senses.exampleCN: 电影里的那只翼龙收着翅膀掠过峡谷。
senses.why: Once an animal is known mainly from bones and pictures, the word can point at the reconstruction people actually see.
senses.whyCN: 当人们主要通过骨骼和图画认识一种动物时，这个词也就能指人们真正看到的复原形象。

senses.title: The type of animal, loosely
senses.definition: a loose label for any large extinct flying reptile thought to be similar
senses.definitionCN: 对任何被认为相似的大型已灭绝飞行爬行动物的宽泛称呼
senses.example: News reports often call any big winged fossil a pterosaur.
senses.exampleCN: 新闻报道常把任何大型有翼化石都称作翼龙。
senses.why: Popular writing blurs close groups together, so a precise order name drifts into a general picture of a sky filled with reptiles.
senses.whyCN: 通俗写作会把相近的类群混在一起，于是精确的目名漂移成「满天生着爬行动物的天空」这一泛称。

intro.en: Pterosaur is a modern scientific compound from Greek pteron, wing, and sauros, lizard, coined in English natural history in the nineteenth century.
intro.cn: pterosaur 是现代科学造词，由希腊语 pteron（翅膀）与 sauros（蜥蜴）拼成，十九世纪在英语博物学中出现。

items.en: Pteron means wing or feather, and sauros means lizard.
items.cn: pteron 意为翅膀或羽毛，sauros 意为蜥蜴。

items.en: Fossil discoveries in France and Germany push naturalists to name winged reptiles.
items.cn: 十九世纪初，法国与德国的化石发现推动博物学家为有翼爬行动物命名。

items.en: English natural history adopts pterosaur as the group name for the winged lizards.
items.cn: 十九世纪中叶，英语博物学采用 pterosaur 作为「有翼蜥蜴」这一类群的名称。

items.en: Fossils spread the word from specialists to museums and popular books.
items.cn: 化石发现把这个词从专家圈子传进博物馆与科普读物。

items.en: Pterosaur survives as the formal name, while older popular names linger in museums.
items.cn: 现代英语里 pterosaur 是正式名，而更早的通俗名仍留在博物馆中。

note.en: Pterosaur is the scientific name of a whole order, easily confused with the popular name pterodactyl for one genus and with the dinosaurs that shared its world.
note.cn: pterosaur 是整个目的正式学名，常与指单一个属的通俗名 pterodactyl 以及同时代的恐龙相混淆。

entries.definition: a genus of pterosaur, often used loosely for any pterosaur
entries.definitionCN: 翼手龙属：同为 pteron 词根，但严格说并不是整个翼龙目的统称

entries.definition: a large crested, toothless pterosaur
entries.definitionCN: 无齿翼龙：同根词，指一种有骨冠、无牙的大翼龙

entries.definition: an extinct reptile group that excludes pterosaurs
entries.definitionCN: 恐龙：同样含「蜥蜴」这一希腊成分，但与翼龙是兄弟类群，并非同类

entries.definition: the Greek word for wing
entries.definitionCN: 希腊语「翅膀」：翼龙名字里最显眼的无声首字母就来自这里

entries.definition: a long-necked marine reptile of the Mesozoic
entries.definitionCN: 蛇颈龙：同为中生代爬行动物，但生活在海里

entries.definition: an early feathered bird-like dinosaur
entries.definitionCN: 始祖鸟：常被拿来与翼龙对比，因为它介于恐龙与鸟类之间

entries.definition: the preserved remains of an ancient organism
entries.definitionCN: 化石：翼龙的名字在新闻里几乎总和这个词一起出现

normalIntro.en: The silent opening p in pterosaur is the Greek pteron, wing, the same element you hear in pterodactyl and see in pteranodon.
normalIntro.cn: pterosaur 开头不发音的 p 就是希腊语的 pteron（翅膀），同一个成分在 pterodactyl 里听得见，在 pteranodon 里看得见。

normal.en: Sauros is Greek for lizard, the same element in dinosaur and in the marine plesiosaur.
normal.cn: sauros 是希腊语的蜥蜴，与 dinosaur、plesiosaur 共享同一个成分。

normal.en: Pterodactyl is only one genus, so a pterodactyl is a pterosaur but not every pterosaur is a pterodactyl.
normal.cn: pterodactyl 只是其中一个属，所以翼手龙是翼龙，但翼龙并不都是翼手龙。

normal.en: The p is silent, exactly as in pneumonia and in the Greek-derived psyche.
normal.cn: 开头的 p 不发音，与 pneumonia、psychic 这类希腊来源词完全一致。

normal.en: Pterosaurs are not dinosaurs, though the two groups lived side by side for over a hundred million years.
normal.cn: 翼龙不是恐龙，尽管两类动物肩并肩共存了一亿多年。

normal.en: The wing was a membrane stretched along the fourth finger, which grew longer than the whole body in some species.
normal.cn: 它的翅膀是一层沿第四指展开的皮膜，在某些物种里这根指头比整具身体还长。

abstract.en: Picture a silent letter taking flight over a lagoon.
abstract.cn: 想象一个不发音的字母在泻湖上空起飞。

abstract.en: Imagine a clawed finger pulling a leather sail open against the wind.
abstract.cn: 想象一根带爪的手指在风里把一张皮帆撑开。

abstract.en: Think of the bones on wires in a museum hall, still leaning into the wind.
abstract.cn: 想象博物馆大厅里挂在钢索上的骨架，依然侧身迎风。

examples.en: The pterosaur had a wingspan of more than ten metres.
examples.cn: 这只翼龙的翼展超过十米。

examples.en: Pterosaur bones are hollow and thin, so few fossils survive intact.
examples.cn: 翼龙的骨头中空而薄，因此很少有化石能完整保存。

examples.en: Children often confuse a pterosaur with a flying dinosaur.
examples.cn: 孩子们常把翼龙当成会飞的恐龙。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「特若搜」——一只「特」别会「搜」寻鱼群的翼龙在海上盘旋；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 希腊语 pteron（翅膀）+ sauros（蜥蜴）→ 现代英语 pterosaur（翼龙）：字面即「有翼的蜥蜴」。开头 p 不发音，与 pneumonia、psychic 同属希腊来源的无声首字母。

sensesIntro.en: Pterosaur names a whole extinct order, then can point to one fossil individual, to its museum reconstruction, or loosely to any big winged fossil reptile.
sensesIntro.cn: pterosaur 先指整个已灭绝的翼龙目，再可指某一具化石个体、博物馆里的复原形象，或宽泛地指任何大型有翼化石爬行动物。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a reptile with a leathery sail for a wing, held open by one extremely long finger.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只皮肤翅膀像一张皮帆，由一根极长的指骨撑开的爬行动物。

branches.en: The group sense is the formal scientific sense.
branches.cn: 类群义是正式的学名义项。

branches.en: One specimen is the count-noun extension of the group name.
branches.cn: 某一具标本是类群名转作可数名词后的延伸。

branches.en: The model sense is what visitors actually see.
branches.cn: 模型义是参观者真正看到的那个东西。

branches.en: Popular writing loosens the formal name into a general sky reptile.
branches.cn: 通俗写作把正式名放宽成天上的一类爬行动物。

branches.en: Both a single fossil and a reconstruction let you say this pterosaur.
branches.cn: 单具化石与复原模型都可以说 this pterosaur。

intro.en: Pterosaur is a Greek compound with the elements pteron and sauros, and its English family includes pterodactyl, pteranodon, and dinosaur.
intro.cn: pterosaur 是希腊语复合词，成分是 pteron 与 sauros，英语同族有 pterodactyl、pteranodon 与 dinosaur。

latinIntro.en: Latin kept pteron in scientific compounds such as pterodactylus, and the Latin-based genus names below show how the Greek element travelled through scientific Latin.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语把 pteron 保留在 pterodactylus 这类学术复合词中，下方以拉丁语为底层的属名展示了希腊成分经由学术拉丁语流传的路径。

items.example: Pteron is the wing element of pterosaur.
items.exampleCN: pteron 是 pterosaur 中的「翅膀」成分。

items.example: Sauros is the lizard element of pterosaur.
items.exampleCN: sauros 是 pterosaur 中的「蜥蜴」成分。

items.meaningCN: 连接两个构词成分的元音
items.example: The combining vowel -o- joins wing and lizard.
items.exampleCN: 连接元音 -o- 把翅膀与蜥蜴两段接起来。

items.example: Pterosaur is the formal name of the order.
items.exampleCN: pterosaur 是这一目的正式名称。

items.example: Pterosaurian bones are remarkable for their thin walls.
items.exampleCN: 翼龙的骨头以壁薄著称。

items.example: Pterodactyl means wing finger in the Latin genus name.
items.exampleCN: pterodactyl 这一拉丁属名意为「翼手」。

items.example: Dactyl is the finger element of pterodactyl.
items.exampleCN: dactyl 是 pterodactyl 中的「手指」成分。

items.example: The element anodon explains the name pteranodon.
items.exampleCN: anodon 这一成分解释了 pteranodon 这个名字。

items.example: Dinos is the terrible element of dinosaur.
items.exampleCN: dinos 是 dinosaur 中「可怕」的那一部分。

items.example: Pteryx is a wing word of the same family.
items.exampleCN: pteryx 是同族的另一个「翅膀」词。

items.example: Ornis is the bird element of bird-like scientific names.
items.exampleCN: ornis 是类鸟学名中的「鸟」成分。

definition_zh: 青春期；发育期
definition_en: the stage of life when a child develops into an adult, with the body becoming able to reproduce
core_image: 一棵小树骤然拔高，枝头开始结出花苞
scene: 教室里的孩子一年之内有的长高、有的变声。During puberty, the body grows faster and begins to change in ways that prepare it for adult life.
sceneCN: 这里 puberty 是「青春期」（第 1 个义项：身体向成年转变的发育阶段）；句意：在青春期，身体成长得更快，并以许多方式开始变化，为成年生活做准备。

pos.zh: 青春期；发育期

derivatives.zh: 由名词加形容词后缀 -al 构成，义为「青春期的」
来自同源拉丁词 puber 的形容词，义为「青春期的；长有细毛的」
形容词 pubescent 对应的名词形式，义为「青春期；茸毛」
前缀 pre-（之前）加 puberty 构成，义为「青春期前的阶段」

senses.title: The age of becoming an adult
senses.definition: the period when a young person goes through the physical changes that lead to sexual maturity
senses.definitionCN: 青少年身体发生一系列变化、逐渐性成熟的时期
senses.example: Girls usually reach puberty earlier than boys.
senses.exampleCN: 女孩通常比男孩更早进入青春期。
senses.why: The Latin word for a grown-up or a youth is the seed of this sense, so puberty names the point where a child is turning into an adult.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语里表示「成年人、青年」的词是这个词的种子，所以这个词指孩子正在长成大人的那一段。

senses.title: The physical changes of that period
senses.definition: the bodily changes themselves, such as growth spurts, a deeper voice, or new hair growth
senses.definitionCN: 这一时期身体本身发生的变化，如个子猛长、声音变低、长出新的毛发
senses.example: A growth spurt is one of the common effects of puberty.
senses.exampleCN: 身高骤增是青春期常见的一种表现。
senses.why: Because the turning point is seen on the body, the word can name the changes rather than the years.
senses.whyCN: 因为这个转折点就长在身体上，所以这个词也可指那些变化本身，而不只是指那几年。

senses.title: A corresponding stage in other creatures
senses.definition: a similar stage of maturation in animals or plants that reproduce
senses.definitionCN: 动物或植物繁殖前出现的类似成熟阶段
senses.example: The fish cannot breed until they pass through puberty.
senses.exampleCN: 这种鱼要度过成熟阶段才能繁殖。
senses.why: The image of a young thing growing tall and forming buds stretches naturally from people to other species.
senses.whyCN: 「幼小的东西长高并结出花苞」这一画面，自然能从人扩展到家养或野生的其他物种。

senses.title: The period as a social and emotional phase
senses.definition: the whole stage of life around this change, including shifts in mood and relationships
senses.definitionCN: 围绕这些变化的人生阶段，包括情绪与关系的转变
senses.example: Many friendships change during puberty.
senses.exampleCN: 许多友谊在青春期发生改变。
senses.why: Once the body begins to change, the mind and social world change too, so the word can stand for the whole life stage.
senses.whyCN: 身体一旦开始变化，心理和社交世界也跟着变化，所以这个词可以代指整个阶段。

senses.title: The first appearance of adult features
senses.definition: the moment when adult physical features such as facial hair first appear
senses.definitionCN: 胡须、体毛等成年身体特征初次出现的时刻
senses.example: A few fine hairs mark the first sign of puberty in many boys.
senses.exampleCN: 几根细毛常常是许多男孩青春期最初的表现。
senses.why: The Latin adjective linked to this word means covered in soft down, so a first fuzz of hair becomes a visible marker of the stage.
senses.whyCN: 与这个词相联系的拉丁语形容词意为「长满细软的绒毛」，因此第一层细毛成了这个阶段看得见的标记。

senses.title: A period of rapid growth in plants
senses.definition: the stage when a plant shoots up quickly before it begins to flower
senses.definitionCN: 植物开始开花之前迅速长高的阶段
senses.example: The young tree shows its puberty in a summer of sudden growth.
senses.exampleCN: 那棵小树在一个夏天里猛然长高，显示出它的抽长期。
senses.why: The idea of a quiet young thing making a sudden leap upward suits a growing plant just as well as a growing child.
senses.whyCN: 安静的小东西突然向上猛窜这一想法，用在生长的植物上，和用在生长的孩子身上一样贴切。

intro.en: Puberty comes from Latin pubertas, the age of adulthood, from pubes or puber, meaning grown-up or covered with soft down.
intro.cn: puberty 来自拉丁语 pubertas（成年年龄），源于 pubes 或 puber，意为「已长成」或「长满细软的绒毛」。

items.en: Pubertas means the age at which one becomes an adult.
items.cn: pubertas 指人成为成年人的年龄。

items.en: Pubes names an adult or a young man, linked to pubes meaning the soft down of first body hair.
items.cn: pubes 指成年人或青年，并与表示初次长出细软体毛的 pubes 相关。

items.en: Puber is an adjective meaning grown-up or downy.
items.cn: puber 是形容词，意为已长成的或长有绒毛的。

items.en: Puberté carries the Latin noun into French with the same meaning.
items.cn: puberté 把这个拉丁语名词带入法语，含义相同。

items.en: English borrows puberty to name the age at which a young person can marry and have children.
items.cn: 英语借入 puberty，指年轻人可以结婚生子的年龄。

items.en: Medical science later narrows the word to the bodily changes of adolescence.
items.cn: 后来的医学把词义收窄为青少年时期身体的种种变化。

note.en: Puberty belongs to the family of pubes and puber, and it sits beside ordinary words for growing up.
note.cn: puberty 属于以 pubes 与 puber 为根的词族，也与表示「长大」的普通词相邻。

entries.definition: relating to the changes of becoming an adult
entries.definitionCN: 与发育成年的变化有关的

entries.definition: going through the stage of becoming an adult
entries.definitionCN: 正处在发育期的

entries.definition: relating to the lower front part of the body
entries.definitionCN: 与人体下部前方有关的

entries.definition: the period between childhood and adulthood
entries.definitionCN: 从儿童期到成年期的过渡阶段

entries.definition: the state of being fully grown or developed
entries.definitionCN: 完全长成或发育成熟的状态

entries.definition: the years of a person from thirteen to nineteen
entries.definitionCN: 十三到十九岁这一段年纪

normalIntro.en: Puberty is the age of growing up, with a first fuzz of hair as its quiet signal.
normalIntro.cn: puberty 是长大成人的年纪，最初一层细软的绒毛是它安静的信号。

normal.en: The Latin root pubes means an adult, so puberty is the doorway into adulthood.
normal.cn: 拉丁语词根 pubes 意为成年人，所以 puberty 是通往成年的那扇门。

normal.en: The adjective pubescent describes someone going through it, and shares the same root.
normal.cn: 形容词 pubescent 描述正在经历青春期的人，与它同根。

normal.en: The suffix -ty turns the Latin root into an English noun of state, as in safety or beauty.
normal.cn: 后缀 -ty 把这个拉丁词根变成表示状态的英语名词，就像 safety 与 beauty 一样。

normal.en: The usual verb is reach puberty, as in most girls reach puberty before most boys.
normal.cn: 常用动词搭配是 reach puberty，例如许多孩子在十到十四岁之间进入青春期。

normal.en: Do not treat it as a medical label only: the word names a stage of life, not a disease.
normal.cn: 别把它只当成医学标签：这个词指人生的一个阶段，不是一种疾病。

abstract.en: Picture a sapling that jumps a metre taller in one summer.
abstract.cn: 想象一棵幼树在一个夏天里忽然蹿高一米。

abstract.en: Imagine a child walking through a thin curtain and coming out taller and deeper in voice.
abstract.cn: 想象一个孩子走过一道薄薄的帘子，出来时个子更高、嗓音更低了。

abstract.en: Think of a small green bud opening on a branch that was only a twig last spring.
abstract.cn: 想象一根去年春天还是细枝的枝条上，绽开一个小绿芽。

examples.en: Most children reach puberty between the ages of ten and fourteen.
examples.cn: 大多数儿童在十到十四岁之间进入青春期。

examples.en: Sleep is especially important during puberty because the body grows so fast.
examples.cn: 青春期很重要的一点是睡眠，因为身体长得很快。

examples.en: The study compared children who had reached puberty early with those who had not.
examples.cn: 这项研究把早熟的孩子和尚未发育的孩子做了比较。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「扑杯体」：身体像一只小杯子，一夜之间被水扑满、涨大变高；只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 pubertas（成年年龄）← pubes / puber（成年人；长满细软绒毛的）→ 古法语 puberté → 英语 puberty，核心义「长大成人」。

sensesIntro.en: Puberty first names the age of turning adult, then the bodily changes, then the same growing stage in other living things and in life as a whole.
sensesIntro.cn: puberty 先指长大成人的年龄，再指身体上的变化，然后扩展到其他生物乃至整个人生阶段。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a sapling that suddenly shoots up and shows its first buds.
core.cn: 核心意象：幼树忽然拔高，露出最早的花苞。

branches.en: The stage of turning adult is the central sense.
branches.cn: 长大成人的阶段是中心义项。

branches.en: Visible body changes and first hair growth are the physical signs.
branches.cn: 看得见的身体变化和初生的体毛是身体信号。

branches.en: Animals and plants go through a matching growing stage.
branches.cn: 动物和植物也会经历相对应的生长阶段。

branches.en: The mood and friendship shifts turn the stage into a whole life phase.
branches.cn: 情绪和友情的转变把这个阶段变成完整的人生时期。

branches.en: The biological threshold and the social phase overlap in everyday use.
branches.cn: 生理门槛与社会阶段在日常用法中相互重叠。

intro.en: Puberty is built on the Latin root pubes, with English forms such as pubescent, pubertal and the prefix pre- around it.
intro.cn: puberty 以拉丁语词根 pubes 为基础，英语围绕它构成 pubescent 等词，并可加前缀 pre-。

latinIntro.en: Latin pubes and puber describe a grown-up person or one covered with the first soft down.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 pubes 与 puber 描述成年人，或长着最初一层细软绒毛的人。

items.meaning: an adult, or the first soft hair
items.meaningCN: 成年人；最初的细软体毛
items.example: Pubes gives the image of growing into adulthood.
items.exampleCN: pubes 提供长成大人的意象。

items.example: Puber is the source of the English adjective.
items.exampleCN: puber 是英语形容词的来源。

items.example: Pubertas is the direct source of the word.
items.exampleCN: pubertas 是这个词的直接来源。

items.meaningCN: 表示状态或性质的名词词尾
items.example: The suffix -ty forms nouns of state such as safety.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ty 构成表示状态的名词，如 safety。

items.example: Pubertal changes are studied in growth clinics.
items.exampleCN: 生长门诊会研究青春期的变化。

items.meaningCN: 表示「与……有关的」的形容词词尾
items.example: The suffix -al turns puberty into pubertal.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -al 把 puberty 变成 pubertal。

items.example: Pubescent boys need time to adjust to a new height.
items.exampleCN: 发育期的男孩需要时间适应新的身高。

items.meaning: the stage of going through it
items.example: Pubescence is the abstract noun of pubescent.
items.exampleCN: pubescence 是 pubescent 的抽象名词。

items.example: The prefix pre- gives prepuberty, the stage before it.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 pre- 构成 prepuberty，指青春期之前的阶段。

items.example: Growth is steady in prepuberty.
items.exampleCN: 青春期之前生长较为平稳。

latinEntries.meaning: an adult, or the first soft hair
latinEntries.meaningCN: 成年人；最初的细软体毛

definition_zh: 宣传；公布；使公众知晓；推广
