definition_en: to make something known to a large number of people, often in order to attract attention or support
core_image: 把抽屉里的东西举到广场的高台上给大家看
scene: 新开的小店印了传单，还要在网上发帖。They hired a small team to publicise the launch of their new bicycle.
sceneCN: 这里 publicise 是「宣传、推广」（第 1 个义项：让很多人知道某事，以吸引关注）；句意：他们雇了一个小团队来宣传新款自行车的发布。

pos.zh: 宣传；公布；推广

derivatives.zh: 与动词同源的抽象名词，义为「宣传；报道；公众关注」
后缀 -ist 表人，指「宣传人员；公关」
词根所在的基础词，义为「公共的；公众的」
同一词族的抽象名词，义为「出版物；发表」
否定前缀 un- 加形容词，义为「未经宣传的」

senses.title: To make something widely known
senses.definition: to tell many people about an event, product, or idea so that they notice it
senses.definitionCN: 向许多人介绍某活动、产品或想法，使其受到关注
senses.example: The charity publicised the appeal on television.
senses.exampleCN: 这家慈善机构在电视上宣传了这次募捐活动。
senses.why: The Latin root means the people as a whole, so publicise means moving something out of private hands and into the view of everyone.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语词根意为「全体民众」，所以 publicise 就是把东西从私人手里拿出来，放到所有人眼前。

senses.title: To announce an official fact
senses.definition: to make a decision, result, or plan known to the public officially
senses.definitionCN: 正式向公众公布决定、结果或计划
senses.example: The council publicised the new parking rules last week.
senses.exampleCN: 市议会上周公布了新的停车规定。
senses.why: When a decision leaves the meeting room and reaches the public, the word shifts from hype to official announcement.
senses.whyCN: 当决定离开会议室到达公众那里，这个词的重心就从「炒作」转向「正式通告」。

senses.title: To draw attention to a cause
senses.definition: to spread awareness about an issue in order to win support or change behaviour
senses.definitionCN: 围绕某个议题扩散认知，以争取支持或改变行为
senses.example: They publicised the danger of plastic in the sea.
senses.exampleCN: 他们宣传了海洋塑料的危害。
senses.why: The same act of pushing a message outward becomes a tool for social change, not just for selling goods.
senses.whyCN: 同一个「把信息推向外」的动作，也可以成为推动社会改变的工具，而不只是卖东西。

senses.title: To promote a person or their work
senses.definition: to promote a writer, performer, or candidate in front of the public
senses.definitionCN: 在公众面前宣传作家、演员或候选人
senses.example: The publisher publicised the young poet with a nationwide tour.
senses.exampleCN: 出版社用全国巡演为这位年轻诗人造势。
senses.why: People as well as things can be shown to the crowd, so the verb also covers promotion of a person.
senses.whyCN: 人不只是东西也能被展示给人看，所以这个动词也涵盖对人的推广。

senses.title: To make known on purpose
senses.definition: to share information deliberately, often after it was hidden
senses.definitionCN: 有意分享信息，常指把原本隐藏的内容公开
senses.example: She publicised the flaws in the design out of frustration.
senses.exampleCN: 她因失望而把设计中的缺陷公之于众。
senses.why: The contrast with the private or hidden state is what makes the act deliberate, so the verb often implies secrecy being broken.
senses.whyCN: 与私密或隐藏状态的反差使这个动作带上「有意为之」的色彩，因此常暗示打破了保密。

senses.title: Describing a widely reported event
senses.definition: used as a past participle to describe something that got heavy attention in the media
senses.definitionCN: 作过去分词使用，描述某事物受到媒体高度关注
senses.example: The trial was the most publicised case of the year.
senses.exampleCN: 这起审判是当年最受广泛报道的案件。
senses.why: Once the action is finished, the result can describe the thing itself, as a widely publicised affair.
senses.whyCN: 动作完成后，结果可以反过来修饰事物本身，如「被广泛宣传的事件」。

intro.en: Publicise is built from public plus the verb-forming suffix -ise, with a shorter -ize spelling common in American English.
intro.cn: publicise 由 public 加构成动词的后缀 -ise 组成，美式英语常用较短的 -ize 拼写。

items.en: Publicus means belonging to the people or to the state.
items.cn: publicus 意为属于人民或属于国家的。

items.en: Populus means the people, and gives the stem behind public.
items.cn: populus 意为民众，提供了 public 背后的词干。

items.en: Public enters French as an adjective meaning open to all.
items.cn: public 进入法语，作形容词意为对所有人开放的。

items.en: English public first means open to the general view of people.
items.cn: 英语 public 最初意为向大众敞开的。

items.en: In the 19th century the suffix -ise creates the verb to make something public.
items.cn: 十九世纪时后缀 -ise 造出动词，义为「使公开」。

items.en: The -ize spelling spreads with American printers and becomes the usual form in the United States.
items.cn: 随着美国印刷业推广，-ize 拼写在美国成为常用形式。

note.en: Publicise shares its root with public and publicity, and sits beside verbs such as advertise and announce.
note.cn: publicise 与 public、publicity 同根，并与 advertise、announce 等动词相邻。

entries.definition: the American spelling of the same verb
entries.definitionCN: 同一动词的美式拼写

entries.definition: attention given to someone or something by the media
entries.definitionCN: 媒体对某人某事的关注

entries.definition: open for everyone, or the people as a whole
entries.definitionCN: 公开的；公众

entries.definition: to tell people about a product in order to sell it
entries.definitionCN: 为销售产品而向人介绍

entries.definition: to tell people something officially
entries.definitionCN: 正式告诉人们某事

entries.definition: to help something become more popular or successful
entries.definitionCN: 使某事物更受欢迎或更成功

normalIntro.en: Publicise keeps the word public inside it, so the verb means making something public.
normalIntro.cn: publicise 里面保留了 public 这个词，所以它的意思是「使某物公开」。

normal.en: The suffix -ise turns the adjective public into a verb, meaning to make public.
normal.cn: 后缀 -ise 把形容词 public 变成动词，意为「使公开」。

normal.en: American English usually spells it with a z, as publicize, with the same pronunciation.
normal.cn: 美式英语通常把这里的 s 写成 z，拼作 publicize，读音不变。

normal.en: The noun publicity keeps the root public: publicity is the result of publicising.
normal.cn: 名词 publicity 也保留 public 词根：publicity 是宣传的结果。

normal.en: A person who does the job is a publicist, built with the suffix -ist.
normal.cn: 做这项工作的人是 publicist，由后缀 -ist 构成。

normal.en: Its past participle works as an adjective, as in a widely publicised report.
normal.cn: 过去分词可作形容词，如「被广泛报道的报道」。

abstract.en: Imagine lifting a small box from a dark drawer onto a bright stage.
abstract.cn: 想象把一个小盒子从黑暗的抽屉里提到明亮的舞台上。

abstract.en: Picture a lamp being turned toward a crowd so everyone sees the object.
abstract.cn: 想象一盏灯被转向人群，让每个人都能看清那件东西。

abstract.en: Think of a secret note being pinned to the town notice board.
abstract.cn: 想象一张秘密纸条被钉在镇上的告示板上。

examples.en: The museum publicised the exhibition with posters across the whole city.
examples.cn: 博物馆用遍布全城的海报宣传了这次展览。

examples.en: Officials promised to publicise the test results within a week.
examples.cn: 官员们承诺在一周之内公布检测结果。

examples.en: It was a widely publicised campaign against single-use plastic.
examples.cn: 那是一场被广泛报道的反对一次性塑料的运动。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「怕不利，晒一晒」：怕东西不利、怕没人知道，就拿出去晒给大家看，就是宣传；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 populus（民众）→ publicus（属于人民的）→ 法语 public → 英语 public（公开的；公众）→ public + -ise → publicise（使公开、宣传）。

sensesIntro.en: Publicise starts from making something visible to the crowd, then covers official announcements, causes, people, and finally the reported result of such action.
sensesIntro.cn: publicise 从「把东西展示给众人」起头，再延伸到正式公布、宣传公益、宣传人物，最后指被宣传后的结果状态。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hidden object lifted onto a high platform in the open square.
core.cn: 核心意象：把藏起来的东西举到广场的高台上。

branches.en: Making a product or event widely known is the everyday sense.
branches.cn: 让产品或活动广为人知是日常义项。

branches.en: Official release of results or rules is the formal sense.
branches.cn: 正式发布结果或规定是正式义项。

branches.en: Causes and people can both be pushed into the public eye.
branches.cn: 事业与人同样可以被推到公众视野里。

branches.en: Revealing something hidden is the deliberate sense.
branches.cn: 公开隐藏的信息是「有意为之」的义项。

branches.en: The past participle describes the well-known result of that work.
branches.cn: 过去分词描述宣传工作带来的知名结果。

intro.en: Publicise combines the root public with the verb suffix -ise, and the family adds -ity, -ist, and un-.
intro.cn: publicise 由词根 public 与动词后缀 -ise 组成，词族还加入 -ity、-ist 以及否定前缀 un-。

latinIntro.en: Latin populus means the people, and publicus means belonging to the people.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 populus 意为民众，publicus 意为属于人民的。

items.example: Populus supplies the stem behind public.
items.exampleCN: populus 提供 public 背后的词干。

items.meaning: of the people, open to all

items.exampleCN: publicus 产出英语形容词 public。

items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ise 构成 modernise 等动词。

items.meaning: to make known to many people

definition_zh: 水洼；水坑；小滩
definition_en: a small pool of liquid, usually rainwater, lying on the ground
core_image: 雨停后柏油路上一小块亮亮的水面
scene: 刚下过雨，孩子踩着地上一片亮亮的水。After the rain, a child jumped straight into the biggest puddle on the path.
sceneCN: 这里 puddle 是「水洼」（第 1 个义项：地上一小片积起来的水）；句意：雨停后，一个孩子径直跳进了路上最大的那个水洼。

pos.zh: 水洼；水坑；小滩
积水；淌水

derivatives.zh: 名词加形容词后缀 -y 构成，义为「多水洼的；像水洼的」
动名词形式，义为「积水；搅炼」
复合名词，指用于水坝防渗的「捣实的黏土」
复合名词，指在浅水里觅食的「浅水鸭」

senses.title: A small pool on the ground
senses.definition: a shallow patch of rainwater or liquid collected on a surface
senses.definitionCN: 积在表面上的浅而小的一片雨水或液体
senses.example: Rain left a large puddle outside the gate.
senses.exampleCN: 雨水在大门外留下了一大片水洼。
senses.why: The oldest sense is water gathering in a low spot, which gives the word its simple, rainy-day image.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项就是水汇积在低处，这给了这个词一个简单而带雨意的画面。

senses.title: A small amount of any liquid
senses.definition: a small spill of milk, oil, paint, or another liquid
senses.definitionCN: 洒出来的一小片牛奶、油、颜料或其他液体
senses.example: There was a puddle of milk beside the bowl.
senses.exampleCN: 碗旁边有一小滩牛奶。
senses.why: Once a puddle is simply liquid on a surface, it no longer has to be rainwater, and any spill can qualify.
senses.whyCN: 一旦水洼只意味着表面的液体，它就不必是雨水，任何洒出来的液体都能算。

senses.title: To form shallow pools
senses.definition: of a liquid, to gather in low places, or of ground, to collect water on its surface
senses.definitionCN: 液体聚在低处，或指地面可以积水
senses.example: Water puddled in the worn steps of the old bridge.
senses.exampleCN: 水积在古桥磨旧的台阶上。
senses.why: The noun was turned into a verb to describe water settling into small pools in low spots.
senses.whyCN: 名词被转成动词，用来描述水沉入小水洼的过程。

senses.title: To move through shallow water
senses.definition: to walk or drive through wet ground or shallow water
senses.definitionCN: 在湿滑的地面或浅水里走或开车
senses.example: The children puddled home through the flooded lane.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们蹚着积水的小路走回家。
senses.why: When you step into a puddle and keep going, the noun gives a verb for moving through wet ground.
senses.whyCN: 当你踩进水洼还继续往前走，这个名词就给出一个「走过湿地」的动词。

senses.title: A small flat pool of molten metal
senses.titleCN: 熔池；坩埚底的小金属液
senses.definition: a small shallow pool of melted iron in a furnace or after it cools
senses.definitionCN: 炉中或冷却后形成的小片浅金属熔液
senses.example: Workers skimmed the puddle before it cooled.
senses.exampleCN: 工人在熔池冷却前先撇去浮渣。
senses.why: Liquid metal behaves like rainwater in a hollow, so the industrial sense borrows the picture of a low pool.
senses.whyCN: 液态金属在凹处与雨水相似，所以工业义项借用了「低处的水面」这一画面。

senses.title: A small scattered cluster
senses.titleCN: 一小群；零零散散的一堆
senses.definition: a small and often untidy group of things gathered in one spot
senses.definitionCN: 一小堆零散、常常显得凌乱的东西
senses.example: A puddle of leaves lay where the drain had blocked.
senses.exampleCN: 排水口堵塞的地方，叶子积成了一小堆。
senses.why: A puddle looks flat and shapeless, so the word stretches to things that gather untidily in one spot.
senses.whyCN: 水洼看起来又平又不成形，于是这个词也被扩大到凌乱地聚在一处的东西。

intro.en: Puddle comes from Old English pudd, a ditch, and related Low German forms meaning a small pool; the exact earlier origin is uncertain.
intro.cn: puddle 一般被认为与中古荷兰语 puddel（小水潭）同源，并由中古英语中表示沟渠的词演变而来，更早的来源不确定。

items.en: A reconstructed Germanic base forms words for a ditch or a small hollow; the exact form is uncertain.
items.cn: 一个重构的日耳曼词基构成了表示沟渠或小凹陷的词。

items.en: The word pudd names a ditch or a shallow hollow in the ground.
items.cn: 词形 pudd 指沟渠或地上的浅凹处。

items.en: Puddel and puddle name a small pool standing in a hollow.
items.cn: puddel 与 puddle 指凹处积成的小水潭。

items.en: Puddle enters English as a small dirty pool of water.
items.cn: puddle 作为一小汪脏水进入英语。

items.en: Metalworkers apply the word to a shallow pool of melted iron.
items.cn: 金属工人把该词用在浅层的铁熔池上。

items.en: The word spreads to any small spill and to a small messy heap of things.
items.cn: 该词扩展到任何小片洒出的液体，以及凌乱的小堆。

note.en: Puddle suggests a small, shallow, flat pool, and it belongs next to pool, pond, and splash.
note.cn: puddle 暗示小而浅、平铺在地面的水面，与 pool、pond、splash 相邻。

entries.definition: a sweet dish eaten at the end of a meal
entries.definitionCN: 餐后甜点；只是拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: a duck that feeds in shallow water
entries.definitionCN: 在浅水中觅食的鸭子

entries.definition: clay worked until it is watertight
entries.definitionCN: 反复捣实后不透水的黏土

entries.definition: a small area of still water
entries.definitionCN: 一小片静止的水

entries.definition: a larger area of still water, often made by people
entries.definitionCN: 较大的一片死水，常是人工挖成的

entries.definition: the sound or movement of liquid hitting something
entries.definitionCN: 液体拍打某物的声音或动作

normalIntro.en: Puddle looks like paddle in the rain: you step in it, water pools, and you splash.
normalIntro.cn: puddle 像雨中的 paddle：你踩进去，水就聚起来，然后溅起水花。

normal.en: The -le ending on a short word often marks something small, as in puddle and bundle.
normal.cn: 短词后的 -le 词尾常用来表示「小」，如 puddle 与 bundle。

normal.en: The noun puddle has the regular plural puddles, and the verb follows the same path.
normal.cn: 名词 puddle 的复数是规则的 puddles，动词变化也走同样的路。

normal.en: Add -y to get puddly, an adjective for a road full of water.
normal.cn: 加 -y 得到 puddly，形容词，形容满是水的路面。

normal.en: Puddle is a close cousin of pool and pond, all meaning a small area of water.
normal.cn: puddle 与 pool、pond 是近亲，都表示一小片水。

normal.en: In metal working, puddle names a shallow pool of melted iron, so the same picture spreads into industry.
normal.cn: 在金属加工中，puddle 指浅层的铁熔池，同样的画面延伸到了工业里。

abstract.en: Picture a mirror of sky lying flat in the middle of a grey road.
abstract.cn: 想象灰色马路中间平躺着一面映着天空的小镜子。

abstract.en: Imagine a boot landing in water and a ring of drops leaping up.
abstract.cn: 想象一只靴子踩进水里，一圈水花弹起来。

abstract.en: Think of a spoon held over a cup too long, leaving a small wet circle on the table.
abstract.cn: 想象勺子放在杯子上方太久，在桌面上留下一小圈湿印。

examples.en: The children laughed as the car splashed water from the puddles.
examples.cn: 汽车溅起水洼里的水，孩子们笑了起来。

examples.en: Someone had left a puddle of coffee on the library floor.
examples.cn: 有人把一小滩咖啡洒在了图书馆的地板上。

examples.en: After the storm the lane puddled at the bottom of the hill.
examples.cn: 暴风雨过后，山路坡底积起了一洼洼的水。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「扑都」：雨点扑扑地落下，水都聚在一处，就是水洼；只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 一般认为由中古英语中表示沟渠的词与中古荷兰语 puddel（小水潭）演变而来，更早的词根来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Puddle begins as rain water standing in a hollow, then spreads to any small spill, to moving through water, to melted metal, and to small messy heaps.
sensesIntro.cn: puddle 最初指积在凹处的雨水，随后扩展到任何小滩液体、蹚水、金属熔池以及零乱的小堆。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a small flat sheet of rainwater shining on the road after a storm.
core.cn: 核心意象：一场雨后路面上亮亮的一小片平水。

branches.en: A rainwater pool on the ground is the central sense.
branches.cn: 地面上的雨水洼是中心义项。

branches.en: A small spill or a small messy heap borrows the flat pool picture.
branches.cn: 小滩液体和小乱堆都借用了「平铺的一滩」这一画面。

branches.en: The noun turns into verbs of water gathering and of walking through it.
branches.cn: 名词转成表示积水与蹚水的动词。

branches.en: Melted metal lying in a hollow makes the industrial sense.
branches.cn: 凹处的液态铁造出工业义项。

branches.en: Rain and spilled milk both come down to liquid lying on a flat surface.
branches.cn: 雨水和洒出的牛奶都归结为液体积在平整的表面上。

intro.en: Puddle has no productive prefix, but its short word-building parts -le, -y, and -ing form a small family.
intro.cn: puddle 没有能产的前缀，但 -le、-y、-ing 等构词成分构成了一个小小的词族。

latinIntro.en: Puddle has no Latin ancestor; its root is Germanic and its earliest form is uncertain.
latinIntro.cn: puddle 没有拉丁语祖先，其词根是日耳曼语系，最早的形式不确定。

items.example: Pudd gives the picture of water lying in a low spot.
items.exampleCN: pudd 提供水积在低处的画面。

items.example: Puddel is a close northern cousin of puddle.
items.exampleCN: puddel 是 puddle 的北方近亲。

items.example: The suffix -le often adds a sense of smallness.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -le 常带出「小」的意味。

items.example: Puddle names the pool itself.
items.exampleCN: puddle 指水洼本身。

items.example: The suffix -y forms puddly, full of puddles.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -y 构成 puddly，意为满是水洼的。

items.example: The puddly field ruined everyones shoes.
items.exampleCN: 满是水洼的田地毁了每个人的鞋。

items.meaningCN: 表示动作或过程的名词词尾
items.example: The suffix -ing forms puddling, the collecting of water.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ing 构成 puddling，即积水的动作。

items.meaning: gathering water, or a metal-working process
items.example: Puddling is still used in iron making.
items.exampleCN: 搅炼工艺至今仍用于制铁。

items.meaning: a duck that feeds in shallow water
items.example: Puddle ducks dabble at the edge of the marsh.
items.exampleCN: 浅水鸭在沼泽边啄食。

items.meaning: worked clay used to keep out water
items.example: Puddle clay lined the old reservoir wall.
items.exampleCN: 旧水库的墙用捣实的黏土做内衬。
